About This Job
The Advanced Sample Technician will be a key member of the Compound Management team within Bicycle Therapeutics’ Scientific Operations Department, playing an essential role in the operational success of our sample archiving and delivery services. This position is responsible for the precise and timely processing, management, and distribution of valuable research samples from both internal and external sources.
As our team evolves by integrating new technologies, this role will be instrumental in the transition towards automated workflows. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in laboratory procedures, exceptional attention to detail, an interest in automation, and a proactive mindset to help shape the future of our sample management capabilities ensuring our scientists have reliable access to the materials they need to discover and develop innovative treatments for patients.
Your Responsibilities
Sample Preparation
You will provide critical technician support for sample processing and preparation, which includes:
• Processing samples arriving from external CROs
• Performing quality control checks
• Uploading data to the LIMS database
• Storing materials in an automated compound management store
• Processing samples from internal synthesis pipelines
• Solubilizing solid peptides and preparing assay-ready samples using both automated liquid handlers and manual workflows
• Storing both assay ready samples and stock batches
• Actioning requests from scientists via a ticketing system
• Preparing custom sample aliquots for specific assays
• Preparing sample sets for shipment to external partners
• Liaising with the logistics team to prepare sample shipments in accordance with standard operating procedures and regulatory requirements
• Liaising directly with scientists to discuss their support requirements.
• Ensuring that laboratories meet all Health and Safety requirements by keeping workspaces clean and tidy, writing and maintaining Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and maintaining lab records to a high standard.
Inventory Management
You will ensure that both the physical inventory and LIMS records are accurate and well maintained by:
• Applying meticulous attention to detail to ensure all sample information is accurately recorded and updated in the LIMS database
• Conducting regular inventory reviews to manage the sample lifecycle, including the timely removal of expired stock
• Promptly investigating and resolving any identified discrepancies.
Continuous Improvement
You will ensure both yourself and the Compound Management team are exploring opportunities to further enable our R&I team, by
• Contributing to the implementation and operation of automated liquid handlers to improve sample processing workflows and enhance throughput.
• Proactively identifying opportunities for process improvements and contributing to a culture of operational excellence by exploring how new automation or AI tools could benefit the team.
• Taking a proactive approach to your own professional and career development, ensuring compliance with all necessary training.
• When required, ensure the tasks of the wider team are covered during absences to maintain operational continuity.

Qualifications
Knowledge & Expertise
• Core Expertise: You apply developing knowledge of sample management principles to complete a broad range of routine tasks independently and are building practical experience in the role.
• Data / Insight: You perform well-defined analysis of sample data, and can identify trends and draw straightforward conclusions with guidance.
• Knowledge Sharing: You share ideas and information effectively with colleagues and project leaders, contributing to team discussions and building strong working relationships.
Job Complexity:
• Task / Project Delivery: You handle routine assignments of limited scope using established practices and can apply basic analysis to resolve straightforward issues with some guidance.
• Problem-Solving: You resolve routine problems by applying established procedures and standard analytical approaches, exercising judgment to select known solutions.
• Strategic Impact: Your reliable contributions to team activities and individual assignments, along with your shared observations, directly support team decisions.
Independence:
• Autonomy: You operate under general supervision, completing routine work with minimal oversight after initial training and receiving guidance on new or complex assignments.
• Decision Making: You can determine the methods for routine assignments and make straightforward decisions within established procedures, escalating issues when necessary.
• Leadership / Mentorship: You may informally guide or assist colleagues within the team, sharing your knowledge to help others complete tasks effectively.
Qualifications
• Experience working in a laboratory environment, preferably in a sample management, compound management, or biobanking role.
• Practical experience with aseptic techniques and the handling of biological or chemical samples (e.g., peptides, proteins).
• Experience with or an interest in learning to operate laboratory automation (e.g., liquid handlers) is highly desirable.
• Familiarity with laboratory information management systems (LIMS) and electronic lab notebooks (ELN).
• Proficient in using Microsoft Excel for data handling and scheduling.
• Strong attention to detail and a commitment to producing high-quality, accurate work.
• Excellent organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and requests.
• A collaborative team player with good communication skills.
• A proactive and positive attitude with a forward-thinking mindset and a curiosity for how new technologies, including AI, can improve laboratory operations.

About This Job
We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer.
The role is to build a new Forms capability consisting of a Java 21 / Spring Boot 3 backend service and a React / Vite / TanStack frontend portal, both deployed as containers on AWS EKS.
The solution will reuse existing platform services for users, projects, project assignments, document storage/S3, Cognito authentication and SES email, integrating with them through REST APIs and JWT.
Forms will be hard-coded for each use case, rather than generated dynamically from configuration. For each reporting period, the system will create a single immutable submission snapshot, with no version history. Project totals will only be updated once a submission is approved, using a single transactional update.
The application should use one common, scheme-independent codebase, with lightweight configuration applied for each deployment. Production deployments will be separated as required, while lower environments may support multiple configurations.
This is a contract of 1 month with 1 month extension possible.
The contractor must be UK-based and eligible to obtain BPSS clearance.

About This Job
Role Purpose
The Post Trade Management team are primarily responsible for investigating and resolving post execution payment queries, liaising with our network of Correspondent Banks across multiple regions to ensure such queries are resolved in good time, to uphold our client experience. A high volume of these queries are in relation to our FX and MM transactions as well as client MT103 payments
The role holder will work alongside the wider team to take responsibility for all post trade FX and MM payments. They will be expected to communicate regularly with our correspondent banks and clients across multiple regions to ensure smooth payment execution and timely query resolution.
As this role involves communicating with stakeholders across diverse regions, fluency in French would be desirable. Fluency in Spanish would also be advantageous.
In addition, the role holder will take responsibility for producing external correspondent bank reports and internal unsettled trade reports
Daily responsibilities also include Nostro break investigation, confirmation of incoming client funds, SSI set ups and the creation of daily payment reports
Role Responsibilities
• Payment Query Resolution: Handle post-execution payment inquiries by providing prompt and precise updates to correspondent banks and clients in various regions. French language skills would be desirable, and Spanish language skills would also be advantageous.
• Stakeholder Engagement:
•
• Produce and present unsettled trade reports, highlighting failed FX settlements to stakeholders across the organisation.
• Regularly interact with Relationship Bankers to update on progress of queries.
• Daily Operations:
•
• Investigate Nostro account breaks and ensure timely reconciliation.
• Ensure prompt response to and resolution of incoming client queries
• Confirm receipt of incoming client funds.
• Generate and distribute daily payment reports to relevant teams.
• Maintain records of team activity for monthly reporting
• Set-up and maintenance of Client Settlement Instruction

Educated to A level standard or similar demonstrable experience.
Experience
• 3 years + experience in Payment Investigations or similar role within Banking Operations
• Strong working knowledge of SWIFT payments and investigations, particularly MT1XX and MT2XX series
• Prior exposure to Foreign Exchange processes and settlement flows
• Familiarity with ISO20022 message types highly advantageous
• Demonstrated experience in managing relationships and resolving queries across a global network of correspondent banks and internal stakeholders

Daily priorities, staffing and operational decisions are coordinated with the Head Chef. New dishes and menu changes are developed with the Corporate Pastry Chef and agreed with the Head Chef before implementation.
Responsibilities
Operation
• Lead daily pastry preparation and service, organising mise en place and production according to bookings, menus and service requirements. Personally prepare, finish and plate pastry dishes, checking flavour, texture, temperature and presentation before service.
• Follow agreed recipes, portion sizes and presentation standards, ensuring consistency across the pastry team.
• Coordinate with the Head Chef, kitchen brigade and front of house to deliver each course at the correct pace and communicate shortages or delays promptly.
• Plan for dietary requirements and allergies, confirming suitable alternatives with the Head Chef and maintaining clear communication with front of house.
• Identify quality or production issues early, take corrective action within the role’s authority and escalate unresolved issues to the Head Chef.
• Work with the Head Chef and Corporate Pastry Chef to develop seasonal desserts and pastry items that reflect Mauro Colagreco’s culinary approach.
• Prepare and assess recipe trials, incorporating feedback before introducing dishes into service.
• Maintain accurate recipes, yields, portion costs, plating guides and allergen information; update these whenever an approved recipe changes.
• Train the team on new dishes and ensure production methods and service arrangements are ready before a menu launch.
• Lead the pastry team during preparation and service, allocating tasks clearly and checking completion and quality.
• Provide practical training and coaching, supporting junior chefs across pastry techniques, organisation and presentation.
• Work with the Head Chef on staffing needs, rota planning, onboarding and performance reviews for the pastry team.
• Set an example through professional conduct, clear communication and composure under pressure. Address concerns fairly and escalate performance or conduct issues to the Head Chef.

• Manage pastry stock levels, ordering and deliveries through approved channels, checking quality and quantities on receipt.
• Maintain correct storage, labelling and stock rotation; plan production to minimise waste while meeting service needs.
• Monitor portion costs and ingredient use against agreed targets and report variances to the Head Chef.

• Follow the hotel’s food safety procedures, including hygiene, temperature checks, cleaning schedules, traceability and required records.

• Actively encouraging and promoting employees to be creative and innovative, whilst recognising them for their contributions to the success of the operation.

• Be fully conversant with all departmental Fire, Emergency and Bomb procedures.
• Ensure the safety of the persons and the property of all within the premises, by strict adherence to existing laws, statues and applicable ordinances, and by anticipating possible and probable hazards and conditions and either correcting them or pre-planning a defence against them.
• Stimulate and encourage a general awareness of Health and Safety in relation to all tasks and activities undertaken in the department.

Essential
• Proven pastry experience in a fine dining restaurant or comparable luxury hospitality setting, with responsibility for pastry production and service.
• Strong practical skills in plated desserts, chocolate work, pastry and dough preparation, and frozen desserts.
• Experience supervising or leading chefs, with the ability to organise production and train junior team members.
• Consistent attention to flavour, presentation and detail, and the ability to maintain standards during busy services.

About This Job
About Me
I live at home in Kidderminster with my lovely mum and my two brothers. We also have a friendly family dog, who absolutely loves meeting new people—she’ll always want to come and say hello! I have my own cosy downstairs bedroom and a specially adapted shower to support my needs. Our home is warm, welcoming and always full of life. I have transport that takes me to and from school every weekday.
I was adopted at 13 months old. As I grew, my adoptive parents noticed that I often fell over, had limited eye contact, and experienced difficulties with speech, language, listening and attention. In March 2020, genetic testing showed that I have a genetic variant involving STX1B and GABR2. I have epilepsy associated with STX1B, which is also linked to learning difficulties and movement disorders. I was diagnosed with epileptic encephalopathy and experience several different types of seizures, including multiple seizures during the night.
My behaviour is usually at its best when I have one-to-one interaction. I frequently become upset or dysregulated and can display challenging behaviour, often without any clear triggers. I prefer to follow my own agenda and find it very difficult to negotiate or reason with others.
I like watching the same programmes repeatedly and can be very particular at home. For example, I always use my unicorn platter for meals, and my food must be placed in the correct sections. I also need the red stars on my nightlight and the same bedtime music every night. My favourite toy changes from time to time, and when I have one, I will play with it repeatedly for weeks. I become very upset if I can’t find a toy and will ask for it.
I receive support from a number of services, including Speech and Language Therapy, Occupational Therapy, my Consultant Paediatric Neurologist, an Epilepsy Consultant, and Social Care. Social Care provides 15 hours of after-school support Monday to Friday, as well as respite care with Ruth and at Acorns.
What I Love
I’m a happy and curious child who loves spending time in my garden, visiting animals, and playing with other children. I’m learning how to build friendships both at school and at home, and I really enjoy being around people who like helping me grow and explore. My carers are very important to me, and being able to go to school and spend time with my friends means a lot.
I especially love animals, and my dog Bella is one of my favourites. Sometimes I can play a little too roughly with Bella, so it’s important that I’m always supervised to keep her safe.
Inside my house, I have lots of toys and sensory items to explore! Some of my favourites are:
• My First Aid doctor’s set
• Dolls
• My play kitchen
• Anything sensory — sand, playdoh, bubbles, foam
• Sweeping the leaves in the back garden
I always know exactly what I want to play with, and I love it when someone joins in with me. I often pick a “favourite toy of the day” and play with it again and again — and I’ll definitely let you know if I can’t find it!
Who I’m Looking For
We are looking for a kind, patient, and friendly night carer to support me while I sleep and help keep my nights peaceful and safe. Someone who enjoys being part of a family home, is comfortable around a friendly dog, and feels confident in a calm, nurturing environment would be a great fit.
If you are compassionate, dependable, and hoping to make a positive difference in a little girl’s life, we would love to hear from you.

Qualifications
Experience in the following is desirable for this role:
• Suctioning
• Peg Feeding
• Ventilation
Essential:
• Administration of Medication
• Experience with Challenging Behaviour

Additional Information
Why choose us?
We're an equal opportunities employer. Thanks to the commitment of our health care assistants, we see extraordinary achievements happen every day. We are transforming the care industry by working smarter, using innovative tech and driving forward positive change. About This Job
The Insight Analyst combines business analysis of data with the design and delivery of trusted reports and dashboards. The role works with stakeholders to define the decisions they need to make, agree measures and business rules, and turn reliable data into clear reporting and actionable insight.
The role defines the data needed to answer business questions, designs reporting-facing Gold schemas within the organisation’s Microsoft Fabric medallion architecture and gives testable requirements to Data Engineering. Data Engineers build and operate repeatable pipelines and governed datasets. The analyst validates those datasets and turns them into reports and insight, following standards set by the Data Manager and Governance Lead.
This role reports to the Group Data and Governance Manager.
Key Duties and Responsibilities
Understand business needs and measures
• Lead stakeholder workshops and discovery sessions to understand how different parts of the organisation operate and elicit the decisions, questions and measures that reporting must support.
• Agree consistent definitions, filters and business rules for key measures with data owners so teams work from the same information.
• Use prototypes, demonstrations and feedback to refine reporting requirements and acceptance criteria.
Create management information and reporting
• Use governed datasets to build Power BI semantic models, dashboards and management reports, and equivalent outputs in other BI platforms.
• Bring together governed information from different systems and databases to give users a clearer view of business performance.
• Identify repetitive spreadsheets and manual reports that can be replaced with reliable, automated reporting.
• Document reporting logic, data assumptions, refresh behaviour, ownership and limitations; support adoption and appropriate self-service use.
Design reporting data and specify engineering work
• Design reporting-facing Gold schemas and semantic structures in Fabric, defining the grain, dimensions, measures, relationships and business rules required for reporting.
• Specify source data, mappings, transformations, quality checks, refresh needs and acceptance criteria for Data Engineering to build repeatable datasets and pipelines; validate delivery against the specification.
• Work with the technical data team to improve the datasets, structures and processes that underpin business reporting.
Analyse and explain
• Use SQL to investigate datasets, identify trends and exceptions, answer questions and find issues that need further investigation.
• Carry out one-off analysis for projects, investigations and important decisions; test assumptions and provide evidence for recommendations.
• Explain what the numbers show to stakeholders, including uncertainty, limitations and assumptions behind the analysis.
• Suggest ways the organisation can make better use of its data over time.
Support users and assure quality
• Respond to business queries about data and reporting, including definitions, discrepancies, report behaviour and access; resolve within the role’s remit or route to the appropriate owner.
• Reconcile outputs to agreed sources, investigate data quality issues and feed recurring defects or improvements into reporting and engineering backlogs.
• Apply agreed access, privacy, documentation and reporting standards, and raise risks to the Data Manager and Governance Lead.

Qualifications
Knowledge and Skills
• Advanced Power BI skills in semantic modelling, DAX, report design and performance, with SQL proficiency and familiarity with other BI platforms.
• Ability to define measures and business rules and test results against source data.
• Strong stakeholder skills and confidence leading requirements sessions, challenging assumptions and explaining findings to non-technical audiences.
• Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric and medallion warehouse and lakehouse architecture, including Bronze, Silver and Gold layers.
• Ability to design Gold layer schemas and write clear, testable requirements for Data Engineering.
Experience
• Extensive hands-on Power BI experience, including dashboards, reports and semantic models.
• Experience leading stakeholder sessions to elicit requirements, agree measures and present insight.
• Experience working with data engineers or platform teams to resolve source and quality issues.
Qualifications
Relevant data, analytics or business information qualification, or equivalent practical experience.

You’ll have the support to develop your career, either within your branch or the wider CCH Group. We’ll also empower you to feel proud of the impactful and meaningful work that you do.

jobs.smartrecruiters.com/ttp1/7440001493.description_excerpt:
About This Job
This role is key in an important phase of growth for Cellular Origins, with authority over mission critical decisions and chance to have real organisation impact. Cellular Origins has established an Engineering Department to provide the professional homes in which capability, standards and careers are built. Cross-departmental programmes bring those capabilities together around product developments and customer outcomes. You will own the Platform Engineering capability.
Your mandate spans Engineering strategy and execution: best practice, appropriate process, resources, skills, leadership development and succession. Working alongside those leading Product and Application Development, Customer Delivery and Operations, you will meet urgent programme needs without compromising platform coherence, reliability or scalability.
What you will own
This is a hands-on organisational leadership role. You will get close enough to the work to understand what is really happening, ask incisive questions, resolve ambiguity, remove barriers and make sure decisions turn into action. You will need the breadth and judgement to lead experienced specialists and close cross-disciplinary decisions.
• Set direction and priorities. Translate company and product strategy into a clear platform-engineering strategy, a prioritised roadmap, and credible investment, capacity and resource choices.
• Leadership. Lead and develop the team leaders for software, hardware, electronics and firmware, robotics and systems integration. Set clear expectations, establish accountability, give direct feedback and build a strong succession plans.
• Drive delivery. Make priorities visible, demand realistic plans, use meaningful measures, surface risk early, resolve blockers and intervene decisively where work is drifting.
• Set engineering standards. Establish and continually improve the practices needed to engineer complex systems well, including architecture, design review, integration, verification and validation, configuration and change control, reliability, maintainability and lifecycle support.
• Protect and evolve the platform. Assure the coherence of the core technology platform and the quality of major technical decisions. Balance immediate customer needs with reuse, modularity, technical debt, product integrity and long-term scale.
• Make the matrix work. Partner with the Head of Product and Application Development to turn product and application priorities into executable platform plans; with Customer Delivery leadership on commitments, sequencing and resource trade-offs; and with Operations leadership on design for manufacture, supply, installation, service and support.
• Represent platform engineering externally. Lead critical technical conversations with customers, partners and suppliers, building confidence through clarity, sound judgement and reliable delivery.
• Build future capability. Work with others to evolve the department to meet the needs of the business, creating talent plans, skill strategy, professional development, knowledge sharing and succession so the department is ready for the next stage of the business.

Qualifications
• Leadership. Proven experience leading a substantial multidisciplinary engineering department through senior managers or discipline leaders, with clear evidence of improving delivery and organisational performance through coaching, setting a high bar, handling performance directly, shaping organisations, hiring well and building skills and succession.
• Relevant system complexity. Experience taking integrated automation, robotics, electromechanical systems or other complex capital equipment from concept through integration, deployment and support.
• Technical breadth and systems judgement. Credibility across software, embedded systems, electronics, hardware, controls, robotics and integration; able to challenge experts and close cross-disciplinary decisions .
• A platform mindset. Experience balancing architecture, modularity, reuse, technical debt and lifecycle needs with the immediate demands of products, applications and customer programmes.
• Engineering rigour. A practical command of quality, safety, design assurance, verification and validation, configuration and change, reliability and continuous improvement.
• Commercial and customer judgement. The ability to balance scope, cost, resources, timescales and technical risk, and to represent engineering credibly with customers, partners and suppliers.
• Clear communication and influence. The ability to create alignment across technical and non-technical groups, explain complex choices simply and build confidence with senior stakeholders.
• Useful context, not a narrow pedigree. Experience in a regulated, safety-critical or high-reliability environment would be valuable. Life sciences or GMP experience is helpful but not essential.
The leadership style we value
You listen widely, then decide. You are direct, fair, calm under pressure and low ego. You stay close enough to delivery to see reality and remove blockers, but you build leaders and systems that do not depend on you for every answer. You are proactive, curious and relentless about follow-through.

Additional Information
Cellular Origins is currently based on the TTP Campus, within purpose-built sustainable offices, labs and green surroundings, 10 miles south of Cambridge.  Our working culture encourages entrepreneurship, shared ideas and collaboration, while providing you the freedom to do your best work.
Our employee benefits include:

• Employer pension contribution of 10% of salary
• Private medical insurance for employees and dependants
• Enhanced family friendly leave
• Life insurance worth 6x salary
• Electric car leasing scheme
• Cycle to work scheme

At AECOM we have a number of exciting opportunities across the UK & Ireland for graduates to work within our Transport Planning Team. We provide advice and support to address the challenges facing society, environment and the economy.
Our team covers all areas of transport planning, including transport strategy development, transport modelling and appraisal, feasibility studies, business case development, development planning, and monitoring and evaluation.  For many of our projects, we work collaboratively with colleagues across AECOM’s many disciplines, including planners, designers, architects, engineers, regeneration and environmental specialists. You will work on local projects delivering improvements for local people, as well as significant projects across the UK and internationally. We are heavily involved in Nationally Significant Infrastructure, delivering major clean energy and water transfer projects, as well as strategic projects to deliver much needed housing and employment across the UK.

• Development of transport strategies and plans

• Developing and applying transport models
• Preparation of business cases for transport schemes
• Assisting in the preparation of reports, presentations, bids and proposals

• Ability to structure & prioritise work effectively through close cooperation with the team as a whole
• Ability to work in a team and independently without losing initiative & focus

As a Mechanical Engineer, specialising in Valve Engineering, you'll support all valve engineering activities for the Hinkley Point C (HPC) Project within the Joint Design Office (JDO), ensuring designs are compliant, constructible, and fit for operation in a nuclear environment.

• Lead technical meetings and manage interfaces with a wide range of stakeholders.
• Provide subject matter expertise on valve operation, maintainability, reliability and nuclear safety requirements.
🤝 Coordination Responsibilities
Acting as the primary point of contact for valve-related queries from the HPC site, you will:
• Coordinate technical activities across multiple valve packages and systems.
• Drive alignment and consistency of technical solutions between stakeholders.
• Monitor, manage and support the resolution of valve-related open points.
• Facilitate communication between design teams, suppliers, construction teams and the client.
• Support project delivery by ensuring valve engineering activities are executed in line with project schedules, quality standards and delivery objectives.

• Previous experience supporting construction, manufacturing, installation, commissioning, or site activities.

What is Amazon Flex?
It's simple! You use your own vehicle and your smartphone to deliver packages locally for Amazon as a way of earning extra money weekly to move you closer to your goals. Schedule a delivery block and start delivering parcels as little or as often as you like.
Who can deliver for Amazon Flex?
To become a Delivery Driver you need a valid UK driving licence and a vehicle. Currently the only available delivery options are for owners of a 4-door car or van.You will need to be entitled to work in the UK and pass a background and criminal record check which includes, but is not limited to, a review of driving licence records. Current Amazon employees are not eligible to be Delivery Partners.
How do I sign up?
Grab your mobile and visit the Amazon Flex website to download the app for iPhone or Android. After the download, the app guides you step-by-step through the onboarding process. Once you have passed your background and criminal record check, you will be able to schedule a block and start delivering smiles!
How long are the blocks?
Blocks vary in length, from 1 to 5 hours, depending on the delivery service you support. However, for https://www.amazon.co.uk/ deliveries, the area served is larger. In those cases, it's not feasible to have 1-hour or 2-hour blocks and the available blocks are 4-hour and 5-hour.
Money Matters. Know your earnings.

Adjust your work not your life.

jobs.smartrecruiters.com/lyst/98860869-f.description_excerpt:
About This Job
Lyst are looking for experienced JavaScript Engineers to join our team in Hoxton Square. We are building a fashion commerce platform that our users love, that brands are excited to partner with, and that we, as engineers, are proud to work on.
The team of engineers and data scientists that work at Lyst are pushing the boundary of how data and technology are used in the fashion commerce space. We are developing an environment and culture that is all about writing great software using the best tools in the best possible manner.
As a JavaScript Engineer you will be ensuring that the platform continues to over exceed shoppers expectations, helping us to constantly release new features and improve functionality. You will work in a product-led cross-discipline team on everything from helping to choose the best tools and frameworks to working with design and product exciting new features.
What you will be working on
• Finding elegant solutions to hard technical problems relating to JS (client side) and/or Python/Django (server-side)
• Contributing to open source libraries that we have either created or use, for example our UI components library Baustein ( https://github.com/ssaw/baustein ) or our CSS inliner that we use for emails ( https://github.com/ssaw/django-inlinify )
• Collaborating with product and designer to build new features
• Building and maintaining internal tools and dashboards, which range from simple server-rendered pages to client side applications built using EmberJS
• Helping to improve our build processes to make deployment and iteration easier and faster
• Writing both unit and integration tests - we love testing.
• Building your own brand and skills. Lyst is a company that will encourage and support you to get involved in the wider community. Events like FOSDEM, JS Conf, LNUG are regular occurrences on our calendar.
• Creating better solutions for everything we do, from culture to the code.

Qualifications
Things that matter to us…
• Progressive enhancement - not because we expect people to disable JS but because we believe this makes you build a better product
• Mobile first - lyst.com is a responsive site and the mobile web experience is hugely important to us both in terms of functionality and performance.
• JavaScript - we favour vanilla JS over a compile-to-JS solution as with ES6 we feel we get all the language level features we need
• CSS - we use LESS (but are considering a move to Sass) and the BEM methodology
• Tooling - our front end build system uses Grunt, Make, RequireJS, Browserify, LESS, JHint, ESLint, Karma, Mocha, Sinon, and a whole load more… but we don’t want tools that get in our way so we are always evaluating this stack.
• Python - yes that’s right, although this role is JavaScript engineer we also do a lot of Python and it turns out JS and Python are best friends
We’re looking for engineers who are excited to join an innovative team to have a real impact on the culture, growth and the code you write. If you enjoy working on fixing real world problems effectively and in the best possible manner. Being challenged and pushing boundries are part of day to day life at Lyst.
We like to build things that solve problems, you will not be constrained by process - we work in small product teams that take a lean approach to building things. We believe that there is no silver bullet to fix the problems and challenges we face: instead we encourage consistent iteration to ensure we are always solving problems. We care deeply about collaboration, feedback and trust; all of our engineers take ownership of committing their own code and ensuring that everything is bug free and reliable.

Additional Information
You will you be working with a passionate and expert team that loves to push the boundaries of the fashion ecommerce space, and you will also be trained and mentored to grow as the business does.
We care deeply about helping the industry become a more inclusive and diverse place and we work hard to lead by example.
You'll also get a nice clothing allowance to spend via the site!

Job Summary
The Senior Environmental Consultant will support the Consultancy Division in providing customers, colleagues, and other stakeholders with commercially aware, technically proficient, and professional environmental risk reduction services.
The post holder will utilise their technical knowledge of contaminated land consultancy, to carry out environmental investigation, assessment, reporting, remediation verification and ‘cradle to grave’ project management of environmental insurance claims.
The role will be a hybrid role,  between home based, onsite and the Risby office, and with close supervision / mentoring by a Principal Consultant and Regional Manager. In addition, and due to the seniority of the post, the postholder will hold responsibility for the technical and financial performance of any project on which they are deployed.

• Leading and supervising project management of environmental insurance claims
• Liaison with all stakeholders including clients, contractors and homeowners
• Undertaking site investigations to determine the extent and severity of impact and assessing environmental risks
• Logging of soils during investigations to a high standard and in accordance with best practice
• Preparing health, safety and environmental documentation including risk assessments and method statements along with reporting of H&S near misses and positive observations
• Management and planning of site investigations, monitoring, remedial and validation works
• Scheduling and interpretation of field and laboratory data
• Production of interpretive environmental reports including conceptual site models (CSM) and preliminary (PRA) and generic quantitative risk assessments (GQRA)
• Undertaking and supporting the design, implementation and verification of environmental remediation works
• Demonstrating a commitment to ensuring consistently high levels of safety, technical robustness, commercial awareness, organisation and customer satisfaction

• An MSc in a relevant subject (beneficial but not essential)

• Possess knowledge of remediation technologies for contaminated soil and groundwater, i.e. have experience of operating on contaminated land projects where there is petroleum hydrocarbon contamination, a working knowledge of key guidance and standards including Land Contamination Risk Management (LCRM) and BS10175 Investigation of Contaminated Sites, be proficient in logging soil and rock in accordance with BS5930 and have strong skills in the development and updating of CSMs

• Possess practical experience of the chemical analyses which can be performed on soil, water and air samples

We are seeking a quantitative researcher or quantitative developer to join our Treasury FX Data Science team. You will help build and operate the models and production systems behind FX pricing, risk and trading. Your work will have a direct impact on Wise’s mission and millions of our customers.
About the Role:
You'll join the Treasury FX Data Science team, helping own the quantitative models and production infrastructure that power how Wise manages FX risk across USD 250bn+ in annual FX volume - serving everyone from retail customers sending money abroad to tier-1 global investment banks via Wise Platform.
The wider Treasury FX team includes quants, traders, analysts, product managers and engineers working together to price, hedge, manage and scale FX operations within Wise in real time. Within that, the Data Science team owns a Python-first, production-grade quant platform which provides multi-instrument pricing, product modelling/monitoring, risk analytics and trading strategies.

•
Quantitative Researcher: Bring deeper expertise in quantitative modelling to develop and improve pricing, forecasting, risk analytics and hedging methodology with rigorous backtesting and stakeholder engagement
•
Quantitative Developer: Bring deeper expertise in quantitative engineering to develop and improve production services, shared quant libraries and engineering reliability. You are expected to

A primary focus in either production quantitative engineering or applied quantitative modelling
•
Python implementation of quantitative work from research or prototype through reliable production use
•
Validation, backtesting and monitoring of model and service performance against realised outcomes
•
Deployment, incident response, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement with stakeholders
•
Shared quant libraries used across multiple services
•
CI/CD pipelines, deployments and operational excellence
•
Monitoring, alerting, and reliability for real-time pricing and risk systems
Where you’ll grow
•
Market data management and onboarding new pipelines..
•
Designing new quant infrastructure and systems with the engineering team.
•
Backtesting frameworks, model validation and risk modelling alongside the Risk team (VaR, stress testing, scenario analysis).
•
Customer behaviour modelling, pricing strategy and product development.
•
Collaborating with product teams to translate quantitative insights into customer-facing decisions

Qualifications
What we’re looking for
•
4+ years of relevant quantitative or engineering experience, with strong Python development skills.
•
Quantitative background - maths, physics, engineering or finance - you can read a model and reason about correctness.
•
It’s a bonus if you are familiar with
•
FX or financial markets experience
•
Term structure modelling, stochastic calculus or Monte Carlo methods
•
Interest rate curve bootstrapping
•
Algorithmic execution experience
•
Data lake or warehouse experience (Snowflake, Iceberg, Spark etc.)

A product mindset - you think about who uses your systems and why.

Clear communicator who can work cross-functionally with other quants, analysts, traders, product managers and engineers.

Experience taking quantitative work into production and owning its ongoing validation, monitoring and improvement.

Experience with testing, monitoring, and debugging complex systems under load

The purpose of this role is to support the Senior Tax Manager – M&A and VP Tax Portfolio and Strategy with transactions currently underway and/or planned as part of the portfolio simplification as well as any other large-scale M&A transactions.
The role includes support on international tax aspects adjacent to transactions including, but not limited to, capital structure, financing, cash repatriation.
M&A tax
• Work with the Senior Tax Manager – M&A to ensure the delivery of best practice tax advice for transactions and provide tax advice to Group Tax Business Partner teams associated with transactions.
• Assist with tax due diligence processes including preparation of virtual data rooms, review of diligence reports and, where relevant, provide input and responses as part of the purchaser Q&A process.

• Work closely with the BD team to assess idea development and business cases for BD activities and add value to development of transactional possibilities through provision of commercial appropriate tax advice.
• Work with external providers & relevant in-house teams to deliver commercially appropriate tax advice.
International tax

• Help design and support appropriate financing structures for a mixture of projects at various stages of the lifecycle, with new opportunities constantly arising through refinancing and as Anglo American looks to grow.

• Advise on UK treasury tax matters, including loan relationships, foreign exchange, loan restructures and simplifications.

• Support strategic tax initiatives, assess value generated for Anglo American, and consider different options and adjustments required to the plan.
• Drive and implement the plan of strategic initiatives, including consideration of the communication required at
different levels of the organisation.

• Support and lead ad hoc projects and initiatives as required.
• Identify and develop opportunities to enhance processes and considers how risk impacts Anglo American.

• Engage with and manage external professional service providers on tax matters where required.

• Demonstrate behavior in line with health, safety and environmental standards and with the Group’s values
• Set the health, safety and environmental expectations for your team and monitor behavior so that it meets the required standards.

• Develop your performance in line with the Group’s policies and systems (e.g. performance management) in order to achieve business goals. As part of this:

• Foster a constructive and productive working environment;
• Drive delivery of objectives and being accountable for your work.

• Contribute to the broader business by working with others in such a way that it optimises the overall business results, rather than just your team’s.

Work Processes:

• How to influence people and manage change and effectively communicate ideas and solutions to senior management

• Strong commercial acumen
Ability to:
• Analyse a whole host of information and extract the pertinent facts and make a
• sound tax analysis thereof.

Undertaking baseline environmental noise and vibration surveys, and benchmark testing of existing buildings.

Authoring technical reports both for planning and design.

Acoustic modelling (CADNA/A and Odeon).

Effectively managing own workload and project managing projects.

Residential/Masterplan, Roads, Bridges and Industrial led EIA preparation.

Site inspections on Building projects and PCT testing.
•
Liaison with Ramboll Environment and Health and Buildings teams.
•
Input to fee proposals, resource tracking and monitoring of project profitability.
•
Effective communication with architects and other specialists to integrate acoustic requirements into the project designs.
•
Technical support for colleagues and contributing to our continued growth and success.

From the moment you join Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you grow with the company. For this role, we believe your starting point is:
•
Acoustic related Degree, IOA Diploma or Masters’ Degree
•
Full driving license
•
Relevant experience in acoustic consultancy
•
Proven experience in project delivery and managing own workload
•
Desire to or already working towards CEng
•
Associate Member of Institute of Acoustics (working towards MIOA)
•
Proficient user of CADNA-A software
•
Experience in the use of Odeon would be beneficial

About This Job
FluCamp is all about improving the health of the population, through increasing the understanding around common viral illnesses – like the common cold and flu. Ultimately, the more that we understand about how viruses affect the human immune system, the more quickly we can find and test better ways to treat them. The end goal of clinical trials like those we conduct at FluCamp is to potentially eradicate these common illnesses completely – or at least make treatment of them as easy and effective as possible.
Volunteers are central to the work that we do. Our studies focus on testing new treatments on real people, in a safe, controlled, clinical environment.

About This Job
Start here. Grow here.
Are you ready to take on the role of Associate Director - Civil CDAE - Energy in our rapidly expanding energy team. You will be responsible for undertaking a technical role on projects within our energy business; typically, our projects are associated with the generation, storage, transmission and distribution of energy both in the UK and Ireland and countries throughout Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA).
Projects include all stages of design from feasibility to detailed design and site construction supervision both in the UK and internationally. Our clients are a mix between large energy utility generators to private developers.
Here’s what you’ll do:
As Associate Director, you will be leading end-to-end HV substation design, shaping grid-scale power infrastructure from concept through to energisation on projects that few engineers get the opportunity to be involved in. A particular focus will be on acting as the lead CDAE Civil Engineer on National Grid Projects. • National Grid’s ‘Great Grid Upgrade’ Great Grid Partnership: Enabling the UK’s energy transition

• Act as Lead Verifier on projects including technical feasibility studies and design reports in the capacity of lead civil engineer.

The BIM & Information Management Coordinator will support the development, implementation and continual improvement of Information Management and Building Information Modelling (BIM) processes across the Euston and FNICAP projects.
The role is responsible for maintaining project information management systems, supporting Common Data Environment (CDE) compliance, developing reporting and dashboards, coordinating BIM activities, delivering training, and ensuring project documentation remains aligned with ISO 19650 requirements and industry best practice.
The successful candidate will work closely with project teams, document controllers, engineers, suppliers and stakeholders to improve information quality, compliance, reporting and digital delivery performance.

Information Management & CDE Administration
• Create, maintain and continuously improve project BIM and Information Management SharePoint sites.
• Ensure procedures, templates, guidance documents, training materials and useful resources remain current and accessible.

• Maintain project information structures, permissions and documentation repositories.
BIM Training & User Support
• Issue, manage and analyse BIM competency and training questionnaires.
• Identify knowledge gaps and develop targeted training programmes.
• Create and deliver BIM and Information Management training, workshops, presentations and user guides.

• Overdue documentation
• Team and supplier performance
• Information Management maturity
• Identify trends, recurring issues and opportunities for improvement and communicate findings to stakeholders.

• Revision management

• Filing structures
• Information delivery requirements
• TIDP and MIDP management
• Record non-compliances, corrective actions and lessons learned.
• Support teams in resolving compliance issues and improving working practices.

• Manage superseded model versions and ensure current information is available to project teams.

• Templates and guidance documents

• Capture lessons learned, recurring issues and successful practices across projects.
• Develop meaningful KPIs that demonstrate project performance and compliance.

Desirable Skills & Experience

About This Job
The Opportunity A lot of designers worry that moving in house means trading interesting work for a single brand book and a slow calendar. That isn’t the role on offer here. Williams F1 Team is rebuilding what its brand means in public, and digital is where most fans meet it  the website, the app, the campaigns that wrap around the season’s biggest moments. You’ll be hands on, shipping work every week alongside an evolving brand system that you’ll help refine as you go. The brand isn’t finished. You won’t be inheriting a museum. This isn’t a social content seat we have a dedicated social team who own the day to day there. Your remit is the bigger, more considered work: the website, the app, integrating with marketing campaigns, performance driven creative, and the digital moments around special races and fan activations. If you’re a strong mid weight pushing into Senior, or a Senior who wants to put their craft against something they actually care about, this is the kind of in house role that doesn’t feel in house.
What You’ll Do:
Website, App & Product Moments
• Design and refine pages, components, editorial moments and email templates for williamsf1.com and the Williams F1 Team app — these are your primary canvases.
• Concept and design launch assets for new app features, product drops and marketing campaigns the wider team is bringing forward.
• Design user experiences across web, app, and fan platforms — memberships, content hubs and interactive features — producing wireframes, prototypes and high-fidelity UI designs.
• Translate fan behaviours, data and testing insights into intuitive, high performing journeys that drive conversion and engagement.
• Partner with product, engineering and data teams to deliver and iterate on digital experiences.
• Build a body of work overtime that visibly improves how the brand expresses itself on its owned digital surfaces.
Fan Growth & Performance Creative
• Design high performing creative for paid and organic channels — social, digital, ecommerce and app.
• Develop and iterate creative assets for multichannel performance marketing campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google, williamsf1.com, Williams F1 App, and more).
• Own creative testing cycles — A/B and multivariate testing — to continuously improve engagement and conversion.
• Rapidly iterate assets based on performance signals (CTR, engagement, retention, conversion).
• Develop scalable creative systems and templates for continuous experimentation.
• Build assets that support the full fan journey — from acquisition through to engagement and retention.
• Collaborate with growth, media and analytics teams to translate performance data into creative improvement.
Key Campaign Moments
• Lead the creative for the season’s biggest activations — special races like the British Grand Prix at Silverstone and the Las Vegas GP, custom livery reveals, fanzone activations and the digital campaigns that wrap around them.
• Partner closely with the Fan Growth & Performance team to deliver high quality assets on fast turnarounds — the calendar is unforgiving and a good idea on Tuesday often needs to ship on Thursday.
• Create content for both race and non race weekend storytelling and always on digital to social loops, optimised for reach and interaction.
• Contribute to specific social led campaigns alongside our dedicated social team, bringing the bigger campaign moments when a unified creative is needed.
Brand & Design System
• Work alongside the Senior Design Manager and the rest of the creative team to evolve Williams’ visual identity — informed by what’s actually performing in market and feedback from the teams using the brand day to day.
• Help maintain and improve brand guidelines, motion principles and component library as we ship more work.
• Champion a fan first and data informed mindset across all outputs.
• Spot opportunities where the brand could be sharper, weirder, more confident — and bring them forward
How You’ll Work
• Take a brief end to end — understand the ask, propose a direction, present it, take feedback and ship.
• Bridge brand storytelling with performance marketing and product UX, ensuring consistency across marketing creative, paid media and product design.
• Partner with marketing, fan engagement, content producers, photographers, motion designers and external partners.
• Manage your own workload across multiple parallel briefs at race week tempo.

Qualifications
• 5–7 years of design experience, with a strong portfolio demonstrating both performance driven creative (paid social, campaigns) and digital product / UX work (web, app). Sports, entertainment, lifestyle or premium consumer brand backgrounds are especially welcome — but a brilliant portfolio from anywhere matters more than the industry on your CV.
• Your portfolio shows real campaigns and live products, not just unbriefed concepts.
• Strong typographic and layout craft across digital, campaign and motion led formats.
• Expert in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects) and Figma.
• Proven experience designing for paid media and growth focused environments, with strong understanding of creative testing, optimisation and data informed design.
• Comfortable working across web, app and campaign formats — you understand that a hero banner, an app onboarding screen and a Silverstone fanzone graphic each demand different thinking, even when they’re telling the same brand story.
• Collaborative, calm under pressure, opinionated about craft but not precious about feedback. You can work fast when the calendar demands it without dropping the quality bar.
• Genuinely care about Formula 1 — or are clearly the kind of person who falls hard for the sports they get close to.
• Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Digital Media or a related field preferred; portfolio over credentials.

We are a crowdfunded company and have a dedicated and enthusiastic community of backers who are helping us create the “Best Damn Space Sim Ever”. We want to build the best we can deliver and we believe wholeheartedly in the value of exceptional diverse talent.
Founded in 2012 by renowned game developer Chris Roberts, Cloud Imperium Games (CIG) is one of the largest global independent studios, dedicated to delivering next-generation AAA games. CIG prides itself in thinking outside the box, encouraging creativity and developing ground-breaking technology. CIG believes in raising the bar for the gaming industry and the gaming community as a whole.
About the Role
As a Senior Lighting Artist at CIG, you will be joining a team responsible for lighting all the amazing locations in Star Citizen.  Star Citizen is a universe filled with solar systems, each of which are filled with diverse locations all of which the player can seamlessly fly down to from space and explore on foot.
In this senior position, you will take ownership of implementing and overseeing high-quality, complex, and cinematic realtime lighting scenarios for Star Citizen. This could be anything from a moody old Space Station in low orbit around a planet to a neon-filled cityscape located on a planet. The art pillars of the game are Cinematic Sci-Fi Realism. You will play a pivotal role in establishing the mood, tone, and visual quality for environments, ensuring the final frame showcases the artwork to the highest possible industry standard.
This is an onsite role based at our studio in Manchester, UK.
Check out what our Lighting team get up to:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Cqt1fl56BlE&t=1s
What does a Senior Lighting Artist at CIG do?
• Create and champion believable, cinematic and narrative-driven lighting scenarios for major locations in the game.
• Optimise and ensure complex lighting setups work seamlessly within strict defined realtime rendering budgets, proactively identifying performance bottlenecks.
• Work closely with the Lighting Lead and Art Director to interpret, execute, and help maintain the overall artistic vision across the project.
• Collaborate deeply with other departments (Environment Art, Tech Art, Design) to pioneer workflows and help create the best player experience possible.
• Act as a technical and artistic resource for junior and mid-level artists, helping elevate the team’s collective skillset.
What do we expect from our Senior Lighting Artists?
• Extensive experience in creating high-quality, AAA realtime lighting scenarios, with a strong portfolio showcasing a masterful handle on mood and composition.
• Someone who is deeply passionate about creating inspirational lighting moods and storytelling through light.
• Deep understanding of material shading, physically based rendering (PBR), and how the interplay of different materials impacts the final frame under varying light conditions.
• A profound knowledge of cinematic lighting principles (composition, colour theory, exposure) combined with the technical know-how to implement them in a cutting-edge engine.
• Someone who draws from a vast variety of reference material to constantly challenge themselves and push the boundaries of what is possible in realtime games.
• Excellent communication skills, with a collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive within a highly passionate, fast-paced team environment.
If you have a proven track record of creating beautiful, exotic sci-fi environments that players get lost in, and you are ready to help lead the charge on a groundbreaking universe, please apply immediately!
Diversity Statement
CIG is a global company, staunchly committed to cultivating a culture and workplace that celebrates all backgrounds, lifestyles, and perspectives. Together, we are creating a space where authentic recognition, appreciation, and understanding of the importance of diversity is fostered by everyone. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we strive to build a team that represents all walks of life, and we want every employee to bring all the things that make them unique to the work environment. The universe is as vast and varied as the people in it, and it’s our differences that make it special.
Fraud Statement
We are aware of people receiving job offers that fraudulently allege to be from CIG. These types of fraud can be carried out through false websites, fake email addresses claiming to be from our company, or social media. We do not ask for your personal info like bank account numbers, identification numbers, etc through social media or chat-based apps, nor do we request or send money for the purchase of business equipment.
If you suspect fraud, please report it to your local authorities, as well as reaching out to us at info[@]cloudimperiumgames.com with any information you may have.
If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Job Description:
Mechanical Engineering Graduate Apprentice
Your impact
At Leonardo we have an opportunity for school/college leavers or individuals already in work and looking for a new career path, to join the Radar and Advanced Targeting line of business as a Mechanical Engineering Graduate Apprentice working in our design team. Your role as a Leonardo Mechanical Engineering Graduate Apprentice will be to support the design and development of our world leading radar and electro-optic products under the guidance of experienced Mechanical Engineers. Our new Graduate Apprentice scheme will enable you to learn how to use state-of-the-art methods, technology and tools to explore all aspects of the product lifecycle, including stress and thermal analysis, requirements analysis, design, implementation, test, build and product support.
Role description
Leonardo’s Mechanical Engineering Graduate Apprenticeship is a 4-year scheme based in Edinburgh. We are looking for people who have a strong interest in technical / STEM related activities, who understand the importance of communication, and who are able to work well as part of a team and also using their own initiative. You will have the drive and commitment to work through difficult problems to find the right engineering solutions. Throughout the duration of your apprenticeship, you will have the opportunity to rotate through different projects and phases of the product lifecycle in order to accelerate your competency development.
Your working week will consist of a minimum of 3-days on-the-job training alongside 1-2 days protected study to allow you to complete your academic studies.
You will study at Heriot Watt University in Edinburgh for completion of a BEng (Hons) in Engineering: Design & Manufacture (Mechanical) through a mixture of work-based learning, distance learning and day release at university. During the teaching semesters, you will be required to attend University classes, seminars and labs on campus one day a week. Leonardo also gives up to an additional 1 day per week to work towards your academic studies. Attendance at University classes is mandatory and must be treated in the same way as any other working day.
Upon completion of your Graduate Apprenticeship, you will attain a BSc (Hons) Engineering: Design & Manufacture (Mechanical) degree.
As a Mechanical Engineering Graduate Apprentice, you will:
• Contribute directly to the development and delivery of our cutting-edge Radar, Laser and Infra-red countermeasure products as either a member of one of our Integrated Project Teams (IPTs) or as a member of our central analysis team.
• Receive training in both technical and soft skills which are tailored to the particular role and area of the business you are in.
• The opportunity to accelerate competency attainment through rotational placements around different projects or stages of the product lifecycle, to enable you to become a well-rounded engineer.
• Continue professional development throughout your career through formal training, site visits, internal awareness sessions, learning from more experienced engineers and keeping up to date with the latest technical developments, both internal to Leonardo and in wider industry.

Standard Grades (1-3) / National 5: (A-C) in English

Role: Engineer – Civil & Structural
Location: Hybrid working with one of the following locations as primary:  Derby, Warrington or Manchester
Our Mission
Our mission is to deliver clean, affordable energy for all. Our Small Modular Reactor (SMR) provides a British solution to a global energy challenge. We are in pole position to become a world leader in SMRs and the UK’s premier green export technology.
The Team
The Civil & Structural team plays a central role in the development of the RR SMR design, supporting the analysis, design, substantiation, and integration of structures across the plant. This includes safety-classified structures within the Reactor Island as well as wider generic design scope such as infrastructure, conventional and balance-of-plant structures, and interfaces with site-wide civil works. Working across complex, highly regulated engineering challenges, the team applies advanced design and analytical methods to ensure structural integrity, constructability, safety, and compliance at every stage of the programme.
The Role
In this context, we are looking for an Engineer – Civil & Structural to report to a Civil & Structural Team Leader. Supporting Senior Engineers and Analysts, you will contribute to the delivery of defined engineering packages across the analysis and design of reinforced concrete and steel structures, helping to develop robust design solutions and support the safety case, generic design development, and site-specific adaptation of plant structures and associated infrastructure.
This role offers the opportunity to work within a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary environment, contributing to a nationally significant infrastructure programme at a pivotal stage of design and development, with exposure to both generic plant design and the wider civil works needed to support deployment on future sites.
What We’ll Need You to Do
We’ll need you to:
•
Supporting the delivery of civil and structural engineering packages, contributing to the analysis and design of reinforced concrete and steel structures across the Reactor Island, wider plant areas, and associated infrastructure within defined scopes of work
•
Assisting in the development, checking, and interpretation of structural analysis (including finite element modelling where applicable) to support design decisions, technical justification, and the maturation of generic design solutions
•
Contributing to the preparation of design documentation and safety case inputs, ensuring outputs are clear, traceable, and aligned with programme, licensing, and site deployment requirements
•
Applying established governance, design control, and quality assurance processes to ensure compliance with internal standards, relevant codes, and regulatory expectations
•
Working closely with multidisciplinary teams to coordinate interfaces with systems, components, architecture, layout, geotechnics, construction, and other engineering disciplines across the plant and site
•
Supporting the development of solutions for site-specific works, including foundations, external structures, below-ground works, and wider infrastructure interfaces as project needs evolve
•
Supporting the resolution of technical issues, escalating where appropriate, and contributing to continuous improvement in engineering delivery across both design development and deployment planning
•
Demonstrating a proactive approach to personal development, building capability in analysis, design, constructability, and nuclear safety principles
What You’ll Bring
As you can see, this is a key delivery role within our engineering function, requiring a motivated and detail-oriented individual who can contribute effectively within a structured, safety-focused environment. You will bring a collaborative approach, a strong foundation in civil and structural engineering principles, and the ability to develop your technical capability while delivering to programme expectations across plant structures, infrastructure, and site-related works, alongside:
Experience & Qualifications
•
A degree in Civil or Structural Engineering (or equivalent qualification), with a clear pathway toward professional accreditation (e.g. Chartered or Incorporated Engineer)
•
We’ll ask you about your experience contributing to civil and structural engineering projects, including analysis and design activities within infrastructure, industrial, energy, or other regulated and safety-critical environments
•
Demonstrable understanding of structural behaviour, analysis techniques, and relevant design codes and standards, with the ability to apply these under appropriate supervision
•
Experience working with reinforced concrete and/or steel structures; exposure to complex loading conditions such as seismic, thermal, pressure, accidental, or extreme environmental events is advantageous
•
Awareness of how civil and structural design interfaces with site-specific considerations such as ground conditions, constructability, access, utilities, drainage, and external works would be beneficial
•
Ability to work within established engineering processes, demonstrating sound judgement appropriate to your level of experience and seeking guidance where required
•
Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams and contribute to technical discussions across a broad project scope
Location
This role offers flexible and hybrid working arrangements. You will be expected to attend a UK office location as required to support collaboration, stakeholder engagement, and programme delivery.
What’s in It for You
•

UKI Finance RP
Finance Data Engineer
The practice
Finance is one of the most demanding and valuable environments in which to apply modern technology. You will work with complex enterprise data, mission-critical processes and high-impact decisions, using AI, data and engineering to reshape how organisations plan, control performance and allocate resources. The opportunity goes beyond building technically strong solutions: you will see how those solutions influence cash, profitability, risk and business growth, and take them from experimentation into trusted, production-ready capabilities. Working in Finance Reinvention allows you to remain close to leading-edge technology while developing an understanding of the CFO agenda, gaining exposure to senior decision-makers and building the commercial judgement needed to solve enterprise-wide challenges. This combination of deep technical capability, finance-domain expertise and measurable business impact creates a differentiated career path that is difficult to develop in a purely technology-focused role.
Purpose of the role
Responsible for the finance data and ontology layer on which agentic solutions depend. Builds the entities, relationships, definitions, lineage and data contracts sourced from live ERP and EPM systems to a standard that supports controlled and auditable agent behaviour. The role owns governed finance data products, semantic models and retrieval-ready data services that are secure, permission-aware, observable and suitable for AI, analytics and decision intelligence.
Responsibilities
• Build and extend the finance ontology covering supplier, invoice, customer, receivable, journal, account, cost centre and forecast line, and the relationships between them, including controlled vocabularies, business glossaries, hierarchy history, ownership and lifecycle versioning.
• Engineer pipelines from SAP, Oracle, Workday and EPM platforms into governed data products, supporting structured and unstructured sources, batch and incremental ingestion, APIs, files and change-data-capture patterns as appropriate.
• Build entity-resolution and master or reference-data capabilities that reconcile identifiers, definitions and hierarchies across source systems and preserve source-to-target mappings.
• Establish lineage and evidence sufficient for audit, so that agent output can be traced to source, with automated data-quality checks, finance reconciliations, completeness and freshness measures, observability, alerts and recoverable operations.
• Define data contracts between delivery pods, and between Accenture delivery and client platform teams, including schemas, quality thresholds, access rules, service levels, versioning and change-control expectations.
• Experience deploying software or data products on Azure, AWS or GCP, DataBricks, Snowflake, Palantir etc using relevant cloud services and at least one of containers, Kubernetes or serverless patterns.
• Work with AI Engineers on retrieval and grounding, ensuring models receive appropriately scoped context, including chunking and embedding strategies, hybrid or graph retrieval, permission-aware filtering, provenance and retrieval evaluation.
• Implement security and privacy controls across the data lifecycle, including role- or attribute-based access, row or document-level permissions, masking or tokenisation, retention, tenant isolation and audit logging.
• Apply software and DataOps practices including Git, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code where relevant, performance tuning, cost optimisation and production support.
• Collaborate with finance SMEs, data owners, architects and governance teams to agree definitions, resolve data issues and embed sustainable stewardship and operating ownership.
• Data engineering
Essential experience
• Production data engineering, including SQL, Python, a modern data platform such as Databricks, Snowflake or Fabric, and orchestration tooling, with practical experience of ETL/ELT, data testing, Git and CI/CD; PySpark or dbt experience is beneficial.
• Working knowledge of finance data structures, including chart of accounts, entity hierarchy, sub-ledger to ledger relationships, intercompany and period close, together with actual, budget and forecast data, currencies, consolidation and management hierarchies.
• Strong data modelling discipline and the ability to justify and maintain definitional standards, including canonical or semantic models, data contracts, schema evolution, metadata, lineage and data-quality controls.
• Experience extracting and reconciling data from enterprise applications or complex operational systems using APIs, files, database interfaces or change-data-capture patterns.
• Experience deploying software or data products on Azure, AWS or GCP, DataBricks, Snowflake, Palantir etc. using relevant cloud services and at least one of containers, Kubernetes or serverless patterns. (AI engineer – desirable)
• Understanding of secure data engineering, including access control, encryption, secrets, privacy, retention and the handling of sensitive or regulated data.
• Ability to work with finance SMEs and technical teams to translate business definitions and controls into implementable data products and acceptance criteria.
• At least 10 years’ relevant professional experience
• Knowledge graph, semantic layer or ontology engineering experience, including technologies or standards such as Neo4j, RDF/OWL, SKOS, SPARQL or GraphRAG.
• Data quality, master data management or lineage tooling experience, including entity resolution, business glossaries, catalogues or platforms such as Collibra, Purview or Unity Catalog.
• Exposure to SOX or external audit requirements, GDPR, model-risk controls or regulated-data environments.
• Detailed knowledge of one or more finance-platform data models, such as SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion, Workday Financials, Anaplan, OneStream or SAP Analytics Cloud.
• Experience evaluating retrieval quality for AI workloads, including embeddings, vector stores, hybrid search or reranking.

IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof.
