Resident Liaison Officer – East London and Essex
Company Description
United Infrastructure is a leading infrastructure, construction and property services company in the UK. We help our customers and the communities they serve benefit from resilient infrastructure, affordable homes and improved living spaces that are fit for the future.
Our mission is to be the partner and employer of choice for designing, building, maintaining and connecting communities and critical infrastructure, creating a more sustainable and inclusive society.
We are recruiting for a Resident Liaison Officer within our Social Infrastructure business. Working with social housing providers and public sector clients, we improve homes and communities through refurbishment, regeneration and building safety works.
About the Role
As a Resident Liaison Officer supporting our program, you will be a visible, approachable and reliable point of contact for residents throughout improvement works to their homes.
From the first introduction through to completion and aftercare, you will explain what residents can expect, coordinate appointments and keep them informed as works progress. Working closely with site teams, subcontractors and the client, you will help resolve concerns and ensure commitments to residents are followed through.
This is a varied, hands-on role combining home visits, time on site and administration. You will help deliver a positive resident experience while supporting the smooth delivery of works.
Key Responsibilities
• Build positive relationships with residents through home visits, telephone calls, letters, newsletters and resident meetings.
• Explain planned works, timescales, likely disruption and any preparation required, providing timely updates when arrangements change.
• Complete resident profiles and relevant pre-start records, including property-condition photographs where required and with appropriate consent.
• Understand residents’ individual circumstances, communication preferences and support needs relevant to the works, including how other household members may be affected.
• Coordinate appointments with residents and delivery teams, understand barriers to access and follow up missed appointments or unsuccessful access attempts in line with agreed procedures.
• Listen respectfully to enquiries, concerns and complaints, work with the relevant teams to resolve issues and keep residents updated on progress.
• Recognise and report welfare or safeguarding concerns through the appropriate channels, maintaining confidentiality and professional boundaries.
• Work closely with site managers, subcontractors and client representatives to ensure resident commitments and agreed support arrangements are understood.
• Maintain accurate and timely records in Total Mobile and relevant trackers, including visits, communications, appointments, photographs and outstanding actions.
• Support completion, handover and aftercare, ensuring residents receive relevant information and user guidance and that outstanding issues are followed up.
• Encourage honest resident feedback and participation in customer satisfaction surveys, sharing opportunities to improve our service.
• Follow health and safety and lone-working procedures, use required equipment and report unsafe conditions promptly.
About You
Previous experience as a Resident Liaison Officer or within social housing or property services would be beneficial, but it is not essential. We welcome applicants with transferable experience in customer service, community engagement or other public-facing roles.
You will bring:
• Clear, confident verbal and written communication, with the ability to explain information in plain English.
• Empathy, patience and respect for people from different backgrounds and with different needs.
• Confidence in managing sensitive conversations and expectations calmly and professionally.
• Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritise workloads and follow through on commitments.
• A practical approach to problem-solving and the judgement to recognise when support or escalation is needed.
• Good IT skills, attention to detail and a willingness to learn systems such as Total Mobile.
• Discretion when handling personal and sensitive information.
• The ability to work independently while maintaining effective communication with the wider team.
Above all, you will understand that we are working in people’s homes. You will care about the resident experience and take pride in doing what you say you will do.
Travel Requirements
The role requires regular travel across East London and Essex. A full driving licence and access to your own vehicle are required.
What We Offer
• A competitive salary and benefits package.
• Opportunities for career development and progression.
• A varied role where you can make a practical difference to residents and their communities.
If you are an experienced Resident Liaison Officer or a customer service professional looking to bring your skills into property services, we would like to hear from you.
Join us at United Infrastructure and be part of our mission to deliver innovative and sustainable solutions to the complex infrastructure needs of the UK.

Financial Risk Analytics provides products and solutions to financial institutions to measure and manage their market risk, counterparty credit risk, regulatory risk capital and derivative valuation adjustments. Experience contributing to or maintaining a design system

Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
•
Experience conducting usability tests and heuristic studies

Portfolio demonstrating recent relevant work across end-to-end design lifecycle

Skilled using design tools such as Figma for both high fidelity designs and prototyping
•
Practical understanding of web technologies and what’s feasible from a development perspective (CSS, HTML5, Typescript, React)

Bachelor’s degree with a focus in HCI, Design or a related field

Experience in the financial industry, ideally with Risk Analytics, Buy Side Risk, Traded Market Risk, XVA, CCR, FRTB, portfolio risk, fixed income analytics, securitised products, liquidity risk, or managed risk-as-a-service solutions.

Company Profile

The Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, and individuals from more than 1,200 offices in 43 countries. As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people is critical to our success. Together, we share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence, and strong team ethic. Department Profile
ISG has created an ISG Data Group (IDG) to provide single point of accountability for the full spectrum of data related commercial initiatives. This ranges from the defensive risk reduction aspects of data security (both internal and external), through operational efficiency from improving data quality, to helping enhance revenue through further leveraging our data assets for providing services to our clients
.
The ISG Divisional Data Office (DDO) is part of IDG and is responsible for the oversight and integrity of the data used for senior management, regulatory or client reporting, or used by internal controls. Using a risk-based prioritization methodology, the team is responsible for working with control groups to prioritize key data which may require improvements in the controls to ensure integrity of that data.
Position Description
Morgan Stanley is seeking a Vice President who will work with the rest of the ISG DDO team to review and assess prioritized data initiatives, review key front office processes and the associated control framework, identify any control gaps and work on defining remediation plans for these gaps, including management of data issues and presentation of metrics around data issue/data initiatives and data policy implementation.
Skill Requirements
-
Extensive experience in the financial services industry.
-
Knowledge of financial products / asset classes / risk measures
-
Knowledge of the trade lifecycle & F2B data lineage/data flow experience
-
Experience in a similar Data Management role with focus on data definitions, data authorities, data quality rules, data quality controls perspective and awareness of industry best practices around data principles/ management.
-
Understanding of Data Governance/Management principles
-
Deep data analysis skills and attention to detail, looks for data patterns, identifies data inconsistencies/ deficiencies and challenges assumption taken by the subject matter experts.
-
Strong risk and control mindset
-
Ability to organize and present data in a meaningful way, including analyzing and summarizing detailed information from various sources
-
Ability to work within a team and to collaborate with peers and leadership across varied functions
-
Enthusiastic, owns tasks, delivery-focused and manages expectations,
-
Sense of ownership and accountability for work. Actively tracking and managing the pending tasks
-
Builds and manages client relationships
-
Strong written, communication and presentation skills, including the ability to liaise with and influence senior subject matter experts
-
Problem solver and asks questions/challenges at the right time
-
Advanced MS-Excel, MS-Word, and MS-PowerPoint skills and basic Data Modelling experience.
Primary Responsibilities
-
Develop Data Management standards for ISG department focusing data definitions, data authorities, data quality rules, data quality controls perspective and industry best practices around data principles/ management/governance.
-
Develop subject matter expertise around key data governance processes and controls
-
Understand from Data Policy perspective what needs to be catalogued for data projects
-
Expected to do understand relationships between data entities used by in scope business processes and do basic data modelling to support cataloguing
-
Understand control environment, support control documentation and mapping of controls to data
-
Understand DQ guidelines needed by data and control gaps, challenge where relevant Consumers on their fit for purpose needs
-
Work collaboratively with other team members for execution of data projects and with subject matter expertise for definition of data terms.
-
Assess the risk rating of data issues, undertaking root-cause analysis, performing periodic thematic issue analysis of data issues, and defining remediation plan/risk-acceptance for the top-rated data issues.
-
Prepare and present updates and metrics around data policy implementation, data issue management, areas requiring escalation and updating to other Data Governance Committees/Data Centre of Excellence.
-
Track progress of the initiatives against timelines, provide status report to Senior Management and highlight risks and dependencies to meeting planned deadlines

Shape the Future of Biologics at Ipsen
At Ipsen, we're passionate about advancing innovative medicines that make a meaningful difference to patients' lives. We are seeking an experienced Principal Scientist to join our Bioprocess Sciences team and provide scientific and technical leadership across Cell Line Development (CLD) and Upstream Process Development (USP) activities.
This is an exciting opportunity for a senior biologics development professional to lead critical Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls (CMC) development programmes, working with cutting-edge technologies and collaborating with global teams across our international network.
The Opportunity
As Principal Scientist, you will act as a recognised subject matter expert, leading the development and optimisation of cell line and upstream manufacturing processes for biologic products from candidate selection through to commercial manufacturing.
A key focus of the role will be driving upstream process development activities using mammalian and/or microbial cell lines, supporting multiple development programmes while providing technical leadership and mentorship to junior scientists. You will play an integral role within cross-functional CMC teams, partnering with internal stakeholders and external Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations (CDMOs) to ensure successful programme delivery.
This position offers exposure to a diverse biologics pipeline and the opportunity to influence development strategy across multiple projects while collaborating with colleagues throughout Ipsen's global organisation.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead Cell Line Development and Upstream Process Development strategies across biologics development programmes.
• Provide scientific leadership for CMC development projects from early development through commercialisation.
• Act as a subject matter expert for CLD and USP activities, supporting technical decision-making across programmes.
• Drive innovation and continuous improvement to enhance process productivity, robustness and product quality.
• Represent Upstream Process Development within multidisciplinary CMC teams.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external CMOs to support development, scale-up and technology transfer activities.
• Contribute to regulatory submissions and technical documentation.
• Conduct technical assessments for new product opportunities and in-licensing activities.
• Mentor, coach and develop junior scientists, fostering a culture of scientific excellence.
About You
We're looking for a scientifically driven leader with strong biologics development experience and the ability to influence across complex, matrixed environments.
Essential Experience & Skills
• Significant pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry experience within biologics development.
• Deep expertise in Cell Line Development and/or Upstream Process Development.
• Strong experience working with CHO cell lines and mammalian cell culture processes.
• Experience leading CMC development activities across the product lifecycle.
• Proven ability to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and external partners.
• Experience engaging with and managing activities CDMOs
• Strong communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
Desirable
• PhD in a relevant scientific discipline (or equivalent industry experience).
• Experience supporting regulatory submissions and technology transfer activities.
• Experience progressing biologic products from early to late-stage development and commercialisation.
• Demonstrated mentoring, coaching or leadership experience within scientific teams.
Why Join Ipsen?
At Ipsen, you'll be part of a collaborative and innovative organisation where science drives meaningful patient outcomes. We offer:
• Flexible hybrid working.
• Opportunities to collaborate with international teams across the UK, Ireland and France.
• Exposure to a diverse and exciting biologics pipeline.
• A culture that values scientific excellence, innovation and continuous learning.
• The opportunity to mentor others while continuing to develop your own career within a global biopharmaceutical company.
If you're an experienced biologics scientist looking to make a significant impact across Cell Line Development, Upstream Process Development and CMC programmes, we'd love to hear from you.
Apply today and help shape the future of biologics at Ipsen.

The role
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a hands-on member of a high-performing engineering squad, building and operating business-critical digital services.
This is a backend-led full-stack role. You will use Kotlin or modern Java, ideally Java 17 or later, together with the wider JVM ecosystem, to develop reliable services and APIs. You will also contribute to modern web interfaces using technologies such as React and TypeScript.
You will work in an increasingly AI-augmented engineering environment. We are looking for people who are curious about AI-augmented engineering and willing to experiment with tools that improve software delivery. You will not be expected to use AI tools every day, but you should be open to applying them where they provide clear value, while validating outputs for correctness, security and maintainability.
Working closely with product managers, designers, engineers, and architects, you will turn product requirements into well-structured, maintainable, production-ready solutions. You will contribute throughout the delivery lifecycle—from technical discovery and implementation through to deployment, production support and continuous improvement.
You will take ownership of significant features and services, contribute to technical decisions, support other engineers and help maintain high standards of engineering quality.
How you will make an impact
•
Build and maintain reliable JVM-based services using Kotlin or modern Java.
•
Design and develop APIs and integrations following industry standards.
•
Contribute to API design standards and documentation.
•
Deliver complete end-to-end features by connecting backend services and data with responsive web interfaces.
•
Use appropriate test-first and test-informed practices to create effective automated tests.
•
Experiment with AI-assisted engineering tools where they provide clear value, such as exploring solutions, improving tests, documenting systems or investigating issues.
•
Validate AI-assisted outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, and suitability before using them.
•
Contribute to event-driven workflows and asynchronous processing.
•
Participate in technical discovery, spikes, architecture discussions and peer code reviews.
•
Improve build, test and deployment pipelines to support safe and efficient delivery.
•
Embed structured logging, metrics and distributed tracing to make services easier to operate and troubleshoot.
•
Consider the operational, security and governance implications of engineering decisions, particularly in complex or regulated environments.
•
Identify and address technical debt, performance issues and reliability risks.
•
Share knowledge, support collective code ownership and contribute to a collaborative, low-ego team culture.
What's important to us
•
Strong commercial experience developing server-side applications with Kotlin or modern Java, ideally Java 17 or later.
•
Good knowledge of the JVM ecosystem and common backend development practices.
•
Experience designing, building and operating APIs.
•
Understanding of service reliability, maintainability, performance and security.
•
Proven experience writing effective automated tests.
•
Practical experience with relational databases.
•
Experience with modern frontend development, ideally using React and TypeScript.
•
Familiarity with CI/CD practices and supporting software in production.
•
Experience working collaboratively in an agile, product-focused engineering team.
•
Curiosity about AI-augmented engineering and a willingness to develop new ways of working.
•
A thoughtful approach to code quality, technical trade-offs and continuous improvement.
Desirable experience
•
Practical experience using AI-assisted development or productivity tools in a software engineering context.
•
Familiarity with asynchronous & event-driven architectures.
•
Experience with frameworks such as Spring Boot, Quarkus, Micronaut or Ktor.
•
Cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP.
•
Developing with containers
•
Understanding the difference between relational, NoSQL and other persistence technologies.
•
Experience building shared platforms, common services or greenfield technical foundations.
•
Building APIs adhering to design principles such as RESTful API design
•
Building observable systems
•
Experience in regulated or financial-services environments.
•
Exposure to payments, transaction processing or other business domains.
•
Equivalent experience with comparable technologies will be considered.
What success looks like
In this role, you will:
•
deliver valuable, production-ready features with the squad;
•
build services and APIs that are reliable, reusable and easy for others to consume;
•
improve the reliability, performance and operability of the services you work on;
•
use emerging engineering tools thoughtfully and responsibly where they add value;
•
contribute constructively to technical decisions, API standards and code reviews;
•
help the team release software safely and efficiently; and
•
support a culture of learning, collaboration and shared responsibility.
Working environment
You will work as part of a cross-functional engineering squad alongside product, design and delivery colleagues. The role is expected to remain substantially hands-on, with opportunities to influence technical direction and support the development of other engineers.
The role may include working on-site with clients, collaborating directly with client stakeholders and delivery teams to understand their needs, shape technical solutions and support successful delivery. This may involve occasional travel or agreed on-site working, depending on the project and client requirements.
What we offer
•
Work life blend: we offer a safe & healthy workplace, with flexible working hours and the possibility to work from home
•
Profit share scheme: In addition to your annual salary, you may receive a profit share defined by the company’s success in the previous year
•
Global and Diverse Zühlke community: witness how colleagues from all our 16 offices across the globe come together…

Job Title:

Simon Boulton
Closing Date:
27/Oct/2026 23.59 GMT
Job Description:
Job title: Postdoctoral Fellow – S Boulton lab
Reporting to: Simon J. Boulton, Principal Group Leader
Contract term: This is a full-time, fixed term (4 year) position on Crick terms and conditions of employment.
The Research Group
Our research is focused on understanding the mechanisms that preserve genome stability, with emphasis on DNA double strand break (DSB) repair, the response to replication stress and the maintenance and protection of telomeres. Our work exploits a combination of genetics, functional genomics, proteomics, biochemistry and single molecule biophysics, which has allowed us to discover novel DNA repair genes and provide molecular insights into human diseases, including cancer, and disorders caused by telomere or replisome dysfunction. Most notably, our work has played an instrumental role in shaping our understanding of the regulation and execution of homologous recombination (HR), a key DSB repair pathway frequently inactivated in cancer, how the ends of chromosomes (telomeres) are protected from mis-repair, and more recently how cells sense and tolerate replication stress. This post is funded by a Wellcome Discovery Award to investigate the function and regulation of SLFN11 in replication stress tolerance, cancer development and therapy resistance.
Project summary
The tRNA nuclease SLFN11 is epigenetically silenced in approximately half of all treatment-naive tumours and is the single strongest predictor of resistance to DNA damaging chemotherapy. In response to replication stress, SLFN11 is activated and cleaves type II Leu-tRNAs, triggering translation shutdown and p53-independent apoptosis. We have recently established that SLFN11 is activated by unprotected single-stranded DNA following RPA exhaustion (Stanage et al. Nature Cell Biology 2025), identified NSUN2 and FAM122A as co-factors required with SLFN11 to eliminate cells experiencing heightened replication stress, uncovered a non-canonical function of SLFN11 and NSUN2 at the replication fork that is independent of tRNA cleavage and translation shutdown, and implicated loss of SLFN11 as a determinant of survival through telomere crisis and the establishment of alternative lengthening of telomeres (Segura-Bayona et al. Cell, In press). How SLFN11 is recruited to sites of replication stress, how it is restrained during normal DNA replication, and which factors positively and negatively regulate its activation, remain unresolved.
The aim of this project is to define the regulatory architecture of the SLFN11 pathway using unbiased functional genomics. The post will conduct arrayed genome-wide CRISPR screens to identify positive and negative effectors of SLFN11 activation, exploiting a GFP-based reporter established in the lab in which every leucine residue of GFP is encoded by the TTA codon corresponding to the type II Leu-tRNA specifically cleaved by SLFN11, such that loss of GFP signal reports directly on SLFN11 nuclease activation. Complementary high-content imaging screens using endogenously tagged SLFN11 (Flag or ALFA) will be used to identify factors required for the recruitment of SLFN11 to sites of replication stress and for its subsequent re-localisation prior to tRNA cleavage. Screens will be performed under conditions that trigger the canonical and non-canonical arms of the pathway (DNA polymerase alpha inhibition and PARP inhibition, respectively) and will be conducted in collaboration with the High Throughput Screening STP at the Crick. Validated hits will be characterised in knockout and knock-in cell lines, and integrated with proteomic analysis of SLFN11 interactors and post-translational modifications generated in the lab. The project offers considerable scope to develop the mechanistic follow-up of hits, including cell biological, biochemical and single molecule approaches available in the lab.
In this project, some of the specific aims could include but not be limited to:
·       Establishing and executing arrayed genome-wide CRISPR screens using the SLFN11-dependent GFP (TTA codon) reporter
·       Identifying factors required for SLFN11 recruitment to, and re-localisation from, sites of replication stress by high-content imaging
·       Validating and characterising positive and negative regulators of SLFN11 in gene-edited cell lines
·       Integrating screen hits with proteomic and post-translational modification datasets to define how SLFN11 activation is controlled
Postdoctoral Fellows are expected to lead their own projects, contribute to other projects on a collaborative basis (both in the lab and with external collaborators) and guide PhD students in their research. The ability to work in a team is essential.
Key experience and competencies
The post holder should embody and demonstrate our core Crick values: bold, open, collegial, in addition to the following:
Essential
• PhD in molecular/cell biology, genome stability or a related discipline, or in the final stages of PhD submission
• Good knowledge and experience in the study of genome stability, the DNA damage response and/or replication stress
• Technical expertise in mammalian cell culture and genome engineering (CRISPR/Cas9, lentiviral and recombinase-based systems)
• Experience of quantitative, image-based assays (immunofluorescence, confocal and/or high-content microscopy) and flow cytometry
• Track record of writing papers as evidenced by publications or submitted manuscripts in referred journals
• Evidence of data presentation at scientific meetings
• Experience of experimental design, including the use of appropriate controls in large-scale experiments
• Ability to work independently and also capable of interacting within a group
Desirable
• Experience of arrayed or pooled CRISPR screening and of the analysis of screen data
• Familiarity with scripting (R or Python) for image or screen data analysis
• Experience of PARP inhibitor biology, ADP-ribosylation or chemo-sensitivity assays
• Experience of proteomics, biochemistry with purified proteins or single molecule approaches
About Us
At the Crick, we conduct research at the forefront of biomedical research. We combine rigour with an open and collaborative culture, and are outward-looking, reflecting our status as a partnership of six organisations aiming to pool knowledge, ideas and resources.
We have a wide research portfolio with no divisions or departments, bringing biomedical researchers together with clinicians, physical scientists and applied scientists from our pharmaceutical partners.
We aim to attract the most talented researchers and support them to tackle innovative research questions. Our science technology platforms provide our researchers with access to state-of-the-art technology and expertise.
We provide an excellent learning environment…

The Learning & Development Lead is responsible for designing, implementing, and managing comprehensive learning programs that align with the Cisco’s account's strategic objectives. The successful candidate must balance strategic stakeholder consulting with direct facilitation, demonstrating a hands-on commitment to executing programs from end to end.

At JLL, you'll help shape how work gets done, for our people, our clients, and the industry we lead. AI is changing careers faster than ever, and we're building a skills-first path through that change, not just reacting to it. Our Learning & Development team sits at the centre of that shift: we're the team JLL is counting on to help thousands of employees across our key client accounts adapt, grow, and thrive over the next few years.
If you've already made AI-enabled tools part of how you design and deliver learning, you'll fit right in here, we see AI as an amplifier for what you bring, not a replacement for it. Job Description:
Your Impact
At Leonardo, we solve real-world engineering challenges, designing and developing mission-critical solutions that power some of the world’s most advanced defence and security systems. Your work will contribute to the Typhoon radar programme which includes the largest single programme being delivered from the Edinburgh site. Next generation ESCAN radars are now in full scale production and being delivered to our customer on the front-line, where we strive to provide key functionality and capability to meet the customer operational requirements
We are recruiting for a Lead Systems Engineer to lead the operational evaluation for the Typhoon ECRS Mk0 (ESCAN) radar against the operational Fitness for Purpose (FFP) criteria.

The Lead Systems Engineer will lead a team responsible for:
• Product gap analysis against operationally relevant scenarios
• Problem Report identification and sentencing

GLP Vendor Oversight and QA Lead
The integrity of nonclinical data depends on more than what happens inside a company's walls. Much of the critical work in GLP-regulated research — safety studies, toxicology, analytical testing — is carried out by external laboratories and CROs. When that network of partners operates to the highest quality standards, the science is sound. When it doesn't, the consequences reach all the way to patients.
This role exists to make sure it works.
Why this role matters
GLP vendor oversight is often invisible when it's done well — and very visible when it isn't. As the internal authority on GLP and nonclinical vendor quality, you will be the person others turn to when the questions are difficult. If you take data integrity seriously, understand the regulatory landscape deeply, and want to shape how a global company manages its external nonclinical network, this is a role with real scope to make a difference.
About the role
Own quality oversight of external partners supporting nonclinical and GLP activities (CROs, laboratories, test facilities). Lead the vendor lifecycle: due diligence, qualification, quality agreements, risk-based monitoring, issue management and continuous improvement, ensuring adherence to GLP/GCP/GMP, data integrity and applicable regulations. Partner with Nonclinical Development, Procurement, Legal and IT.
• Vendor Lifecycle and Governance: Run risk-based qualification and requalification, draft and maintain Quality Agreements, and set vendor KPIs and governance forums, ensuring actions and CAPAs are closed.
• Inspections: Identify and prioritise vendors for audit on a risk basis; planning, conducting and grading sits with the audit function. Confirm vendor CAPAs are fit for purpose and run effectiveness checks. Coordinate inspection readiness and front- and back-room support.
• Quality Systems and Compliance: Ensure vendor practices meet GLP/GCP/GMP, OECD GLP, 21 CFR Part 58, ICH, ISO and data integrity (ALCOA+). Provide input on third-party deviations, change control, CAPA, and the QMS.
• Risk Management and Continuous Improvement: Lead vendor risk assessments (risk registers, FMEA) to set oversight frequency, improve vendor performance, and present trends at management reviews.
• Cross-Functional Partnership: Embed quality requirements in scopes of work and contracts, guide technology transfers and data flows, and train internal stakeholders.
• Maintain and share knowledge of Regulations and Requirements: Stay current with GLP and GxP regulations and translate changes into CSL requirements.
Position Qualifications and Experience Requirements:
Education: Bachelor's degree in a relevant scientific discipline.
Experience: 3+ years of GxP quality experience with direct vendor/CRO oversight and/or auditing (GLP/GCP/GMP), nonclinical/GLP preferred. Knowledge of OECD GLP, 21 CFR Part 58, Annex 11/Part 11 and data integrity (ALCOA+). Strong communication and negotiation skills.
Competencies: Works with limited supervision across multinational teams. Strong analytical, problem-solving, influencing and organisational skills. Knowledge of QMS implementation, regulatory frameworks and audit/inspection management.
About CSL Seqirus
CSL Seqirus is part of CSL. As one of the largest influenza vaccine providers in the world, CSL Seqirus is a major contributor to the prevention of influenza globally and a transcontinental partner in pandemic preparedness. With state-of-the-art production facilities in the U.S., the U.K. and Australia, CSL Seqirus utilizes egg, cell and adjuvant technologies to offer a broad portfolio of differentiated influenza vaccines in more than 20 countries around the world.

Platform Engineer - Content Protection
About the Springer Nature Group
Springer Nature opens the doors to discovery for researchers, educators, clinicians, and other professionals. Every day, around the globe, our imprints, books, journals, platforms, and technology solutions reach millions of people. For over 175 years our brands and imprints have been a trusted source of knowledge to these communities. As AI, machine intelligence and agentic technologies reshape how research is discovered and consumed, we have a responsibility to ensure knowledge remains both discoverable and protected.
About the role
The way academic research is communicated is changing rapidly. Increasingly, Springer Nature content is being accessed through search engines, discovery platforms, AI-powered services, machine agents and content aggregation ecosystems. This creates significant opportunities to extend the reach and impact of research, but also introduces new challenges around content extraction, automated access, platform stability and commercial value protection.
The Platform Engineer - Content Protection role sits within the Off-platform Discovery and Content Protection team and is responsible for turning analytical insight and content protection strategy into operational controls. Working closely with the Data Analyst, Product Manager, Managed Security Services, SEO teams, Product teams and Platform Engineering teams, this role owns the design, implementation and operation of traffic management and content protection controls.
The role is responsible for ensuring Springer Nature can maximise discoverability while protecting content, platform performance and future business models. You will continuously evolve controls and responses to address emerging forms of automated access, including AI-driven and agentic technologies, while ensuring legitimate users retain access to our platforms and content.
Responsibilities
Content Protection Execution & Operational Ownership
• Build, operate and continuously improve WAF signals, policies and rules that detect and mitigate automated scraping, content extraction and abusive traffic.
• Own the lifecycle of traffic protection controls including design, testing, deployment, tuning, validation and retirement.
• Implement rate-limiting, bot-management and traffic-shaping strategies aligned to business objectives and platform requirements.
• Ensure protection controls are effective without negatively impacting legitimate discoverability, accessibility or customer experience.
• Turn analytical signals and intelligence into practical enforcement controls and measurable operational outcomes.
Incident Management & Response
• Lead response activities relating to scraping, automated abuse, enumeration and traffic-related incidents.
• Maintain operational playbooks and runbooks for detection, escalation, mitigation and recovery.
• Implement controls using staged rollout approaches, balancing risk reduction with customer impact.
• Monitor effectiveness of controls and continually improve protection capabilities.
Fastly Partnership & Vendor Management
• Own the day-to-day technical relationship with Fastly MSS and associated content protection tooling.
• Review, validate and operationalise Fastly recommendations and outputs.
• Work with Fastly to maximise value from platform capabilities and identify future improvement opportunities.
• Coordinate changes with stakeholders and communicate impacts, dependencies and implementation plans.
Cross-functional Collaboration & Future Capability Development
• Partner closely with the Data Analyst to operationalise detection signals and validate outcomes.
• Work with SEO teams to ensure legitimate crawlers and discovery services remain appropriately supported.
• Support Product and Platform teams with traffic-aware architectural decisions.
• Help define organisational policies relating to acceptable, non-desirable and malicious automated access.
• Contribute to future approaches for managing AI agents, machine access and emerging content consumption models.
What's Expected
In 1–3 Months:
• Build strong relationships with Managed Services vendor, Product, Platform Engineering, SEO and Analytics stakeholders.
• Develop an understanding of existing WAF configurations, controls and operating processes.
• Review recent incidents and identify immediate improvement opportunities.
• Begin establishing operational playbooks and governance processes.
By 3–6 Months you will:
• Establish repeatable workflows for traffic anomaly detection and response.
• Create clear ownership and decision-making processes for content protection activities.
• Reduce engineering involvement in reactive mitigation activities.
• Deliver measurable improvements in response capability and operational readiness.
By 6–12 Months you will:
• Operate a mature content protection capability integrated into platform operations.
• Develop trusted partnerships with Fastly and internal stakeholders.
• Improve protection against both high-volume and slow accumulation content extraction techniques.
• Lay the foundations for managing AI-driven and agentic access patterns at scale.
• Help Springer Nature balance discoverability, content protection and future commercial opportunities.
Essential Skills & Experience
• Hands-on WAF engineering experience, ideally with Fastly Next-Gen WAF (Signal Sciences) or equivalent platforms.
• Experience implementing bot management, rate limiting and traffic management controls.
• Experience responding to scraping, DDoS, automated abuse or similar traffic-management incidents.
• Strong understanding of HTTP, TLS, CDN and edge technologies.
• Ability to balance security, operational and business considerations when designing controls.
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
Desirable
• Experience with Fastly, Signal Sciences, edge compute or similar technologies.
• Experience working alongside security operations or managed security services teams.
• Experience with entitlement, identity or access-management systems.
• Understanding of SEO, crawler behaviour and digital discoverability ecosystems.
• Experience in academic publishing, research platforms or content-rich digital businesses.
• Experience working with emerging AI, agentic or machine-access use cases.
At Springer Nature, our mission is to be part of progress – and that begins with inclusion: of people, perspectives, and ideas. We believe that diverse perspectives drive progress, and we are committed to creating an environment where people and ideas can flourish. If you have any access needs related to disability, neurodivergence or a chronic condition, please contact us so we can make all necessary accommodations.

MORE THAN YOU EXPECTED

NEW GROUND WON’T BREAK ITSELF.
Every day our teams help people in businesses and communities to do what is right and achieve their goals.
A look into the role
Our clients’ most senior decision-makers, such as CFOs, work with many parts of our firm at once. They should hear from us as one Grant Thornton, not as several separate teams. As our Buyer & Audience Programme Manager, you’ll make that happen.
Joining our Commercial Growth & Strategy team and reporting to the Head of Demand Generation, you’ll lead our firmwide programmes for a small number of priority senior buyers, starting with our Finance Leaders Programme for CFOs. This is a balanced role, roughly half strategy and half hands-on delivery. You’ll shape who we talk to, why, and what works, then brief our Campaigns team to bring it to life and guide go-to-market (GTM) leads across the firm who want to reach the same audience. It’s a new role with real room to grow: we’re starting focused, proving the model, and expanding to more buyer groups over time.
You won’t be starting from scratch. One of our largest buyer programmes is already up and running and working well, giving you a proven template to learn from and evolve, and the team has plenty of know-how to share. This is a chance to get under the skin of what our buyers really care about, put the client first, and make a real difference to how we engage them.

• Convene and chair an editorial and advisory board for each buyer, bringing together service line and sector representatives to steer themes, research and content

• Bring buyer and audience priorities into the firmwide planning cycle

We’ve set ambitious growth targets for the firm, and we need the right people to help us achieve these. We’re looking for people who will bring ambition and drive to their role. In changing markets, we need to be able to work at pace and be adaptable to change and to be curious, asking questions of ourselves, each other and our clients to ensure we are delivering the services and quality we expect.

Cross-functional collaboration sits at the core of the role. cloudimperiumgames.wd503.myworkdayjobs.c.description_excerpt:
We are a crowdfunded company and have a dedicated and enthusiastic community of backers who are helping us create the “Best Damn Space Sim Ever”. We want to build the best we can deliver and we believe wholeheartedly in the value of exceptional diverse talent.
Founded in 2012 by Chris Roberts, Cloud Imperium Games (CIG) is one of the largest independent game studios in the world – and home to some of the most ambitious vehicle art in the industry. From single seater fighters to capital size ships, our Vehicle Artists help bring the Star Citizen universe to life, working at a level of detail and craftmanship few studios attempt. We’re a team that thrives on pushing boundaries, and we’re looking for artists who want to do the same.
About the Role
We’re looking for a Vehicle Artist with hard surface modelling experience to join our team. You’ll work closely with designers, organised into strike teams, to design and build ships of all shapes and sizes – and help craft the flyable, multiplayer-ready levels players will explore.
This role calls for a strong grasp of industrial design and the technical know-how to take a concept from initial model through to a fully functioning ship in the Star Citizen universe – including the software we use and the specific functional areas (cockpits, landing gear, cargo systems, and more) that need to come together. You’ll be working in a collaborative, team-orientated environment, communicating closely with designers and artists across other disciplines throughout development.
What does a Vehicle Artist at CIG do?
• Work from concept models and images to turn them into fully functional, flyable works of art.
• Collaborate with designers, technical artists, and partner studios to understand and implement correct file naming and directory structure requirements within the engine’s limitations.
• As part of a team, maintain the high standards of modelling, texturing, PBR material creation, and manufacturer design cues to provide consistent and high-quality models.
• Work with technical artists and animators to deliver ‘animation ready’ solutions, landing gear, cockpits, cargo doors, ejection seats etc.
What do we expect from our Vehicle Artists?
• Hard surface modelling experience.
• Good working knowledge of 3DS Max and Photoshop.
• An eye for detail while maintaining efficient model making.
• A keen eye for industrial design.
• Avid gamer with a love of sci-fi.
Diversity Statement
CIG is a global company, staunchly committed to cultivating a culture and workplace that celebrates all backgrounds, lifestyles, and perspectives. Together, we are creating a space where authentic recognition, appreciation, and understanding of the importance of diversity is fostered by everyone. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we strive to build a team that represents all walks of life, and we want every employee to bring all the things that make them unique to the work environment. The universe is as vast and varied as the people in it, and it’s our differences that make it special.
Fraud Statement
We are aware of people receiving job offers that fraudulently allege to be from CIG. These types of fraud can be carried out through false websites, fake email addresses claiming to be from our company, or social media. We do not ask for your personal info like bank account numbers, identification numbers, etc through social media or chat-based apps, nor do we request or send money for the purchase of business equipment.
If you suspect fraud, please report it to your local authorities, as well as reaching out to us at info[@]cloudimperiumgames.com with any information you may have.
If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

The Privacy Product Lead is the product owner for consent and privacy-related products in EMEA. This role owns the product roadmap, requirements and delivery sequencing for our consent capabilities, including the management and development of existing consent mechanisms.
The role works closely with our data and privacy compliance function to translate legal and regulatory requirements into clear product requirements, and with global product and engineering teams to ensure those requirements are understood, prioritised and delivered.

This role does not own privacy policy, regulatory interpretation or compliance - that sits with Privacy. This role owns the product requirements, roadmap, prioritisation and technical readiness for the domain

·        IAB Europe Transparency & Consent Framework (TCF).
·        Pan-European experience in media or ad tech preferred.
Deep privacy or legal expertise is not required. The role will work closely with dedicated Privacy specialists who own regulatory interpretation and compliance.
What does success look like?
Success will be evident when consent and privacy-related products have clear ownership, a well-defined roadmap, and are evolving alongside the needs of our advertising, data and measurement products.
Privacy and Product operate as close partners, with regulatory requirements translated into clear product requirements and incorporated early in the development process. kla.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/search/job/new.description_excerpt:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
Group/Division
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA's Central Engineering organization is made up of nine Centers of Excellence (CoEs) spanning disciplines like automation, motion control, sensors, platform design, and packaging. Each CoE contributes not only technical deliverables but also deep expertise, best practices, and advanced tools that elevate both what we build—and how we build it.
What You'll Do
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
We are looking for an experienced Mechanical Engineering Manager to join our Central Engineering team in Newport, Wales.
In this role, you will lead and provide technical guidance to an engineering team supporting projects across KLA's product divisions. Working closely with global engineering teams and key stakeholders, you will ensure the successful delivery of innovative engineering solutions while driving technical excellence, collaboration and continuous improvement.
The successful candidate will combine a strong mechanical engineering foundation with proven people leadership, sound technical judgement, and the ability to work effectively across multiple disciplines, product groups and international teams.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead, mentor and develop a growing multidisciplinary team, creating an inclusive, collaborative and high-performing environment.
• Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and product groups, ensuring priorities, requirements and expectations are aligned.
• Provide technical guidance and informed oversight on mechanical engineering activity, while empowering subject-matter experts across the wider team.
• Lead complex projects involving multiple stakeholders, balancing technical, commercial, quality and schedule considerations.
• Support the full mechanical design lifecycle where required, including requirements definition, feasibility, design reviews, supplier engagement, system integration and testing.
• Drive continuous improvement, innovation and consistent engineering practice across the team.
• Manage direct employees, contractors and external suppliers as required, with clear accountability for quality and delivery.
• Support team growth through recruitment, onboarding, coaching and professional development.
• Work collaboratively with global colleagues and stakeholders, including travel to the United States and other international locations.
Minimum Qualifications
Essential experience and capabilities
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
• Proven experience leading and developing people within a mechanical engineering or technical environment.
• A strong mechanical engineering background, with the credibility to guide technical teams and contribute to engineering decisions.
• Experience managing multidisciplinary teams and working across different technical specialisms.
• Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with multiple product groups and global teams.
• Knowledge of mechanical design tools and methods such as 3D CAD, design for manufacture, GD&T, FEA or CFD.
• Experience working with contractors, subcontractors, turn-key suppliers or component suppliers.
Occasional domestic and international travel (up to 20%), including to the United States, may be required as part of this role.
Our Benefits package includes:
Annual leave starting at 25 days (plus bank holidays), contributory pension scheme, global bonus plan, cash health plan, cycle to work scheme, share scheme, rewards scheme, and life assurance.
About KLA
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
Use of AI Statement
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.
KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Partnering across business, technology, and change teams, you will assess current-state operations, identify opportunities for improvement, and design future-state solutions that strengthen organizational effectiveness and client outcomes. Business Architecture & Operating Model Development

• Define and maintain standards, methodologies and governance for business architecture across the organisation.
• Ensure alignment between business strategy, operating model design and delivery initiatives and help transform strategy into executable change.
Capability Assessment & Maturity Improvement
• Assess business capabilities and organisational maturity against industry best practices and strategic objectives.
• Identify capability gaps, dependencies, risks and constraints that may impact business performance.
• Define improvement opportunities and prioritised capability development plans.
• Track progress toward target-state capability maturity.

• Investigate complex business challenges and identify root causes of organisational issues.

• Facilitate workshops and stakeholder engagement sessions to gather information and validate findings.
• Present insights and recommendations to leadership teams in a clear and actionable manner.

• Support the assurance activities undertaken by the Business Change team to ensure value and benefits realisation.
Governance & Assurance

• Identify and communicate business risks, impacts and dependencies.

Desirable

• Define and execute the OT engineering strategy and multi-year infrastructure roadmap, aligning technology investments with operational and security objectives.

• Own the enterprise Active Directory and hybrid Azure AD / Entra ID architecture for OT environments, governing identity lifecycle, Group Policy, privileged access, and directory services integration.

• Oversee design, deployment, and management of security appliances within OT infrastructure: NGFWs, NAC, IPS, and web application firewalls.

• Lead infrastructure disaster recovery and business continuity planning, testing, and execution for OT systems.
• Collaborate with the Director of OT Cybersecurity to integrate engineering infrastructure into the broader OT security architecture.
• Manage vendor relationships, licensing, support contracts, and procurement.
• Establish and enforce change management, configuration management, and documentation standards.
• Drive team capability development through structured training, mentoring, and certification programs.
• Produce executive-level reporting on infrastructure health, capacity, risk, and programme status.
• Lead cross-functional engineering projects involving OT network, cybersecurity, endpoint, and operational teams.
Requirements:
• 15+ years infrastructure engineering; 8+ years in OT, ICS, or critical infrastructure in a senior or leadership capacity.
• Expert-level Active Directory design, administration, and governance in OT environments.

The Field Manager is responsible for the operational leadership, performance, safety, quality, wellbeing and development of a team of field engineers delivering planned preventative maintenance or reactive telecoms infrastructure services across the Genesis Maintenance contract.

The Field Manager owns team utilisation, productivity, safe working, quality, compliance and customer delivery. Successes are recognised as team achievements, while failures, risks and shortfalls must be actively owned, investigated and managed through timely corrective action, coaching, performance management and escalation where required.

Key Responsibilities
Leadership, Accountability & Team Performance

• Promote a positive culture focused on accountability, teamwork, inclusion, learning and high standards.
Operational Delivery, Utilisation & Productivity

• Review service failures, missed commitments and repeat issues, establish root causes and implement actions to prevent recurrence.
• Maintain accurate operational awareness and provide clear, evidence-based performance updates to senior management.
Quality & Right First Time Delivery
• Review quality results, audit outcomes, defects, rework and recurring failure themes, ensuring findings are communicated to the relevant engineer and acted upon.
• Implement coaching, briefings, targeted support and performance improvement actions where standards are not met.
• Work collaboratively with the Quality Team, operational colleagues, systems teams and supply chain to resolve issues and improve field completion standards.
• Ensure corrective actions are completed, recorded and followed through to effective closure.
Health, Safety & Safe Working
• Ensure engineers comply with Health and Safety legislation, company procedures, client requirements, risk assessments and safe systems of work.
• Conduct regular site visits, safety conversations and field engagements to verify standards in practice.

Resource, Capability & Workforce Planning

• Monitor vehicle compliance, condition, maintenance and utilisation, addressing concerns promptly.
• Promote responsible use, care and accurate recording of company assets and equipment.

Semtech Corporation is a global leader in high-performance analog and mixed-signal semiconductors, delivering advanced solutions that enable next-generation infrastructure, industrial systems, consumer electronics, and communications technologies.

This role sits within a world-class IC development team based in Stansted (UK) and Ottawa (Canada), working on high-speed transimpedance amplifier (TIA) and laser driver (LD) ICs supporting data rates up to 200G. You will report into the Design Centre Manager and contribute directly to the development of next-generation high-speed analogue IC products from concept through to volume production.
Job Summary:
As an Analog IC Design Engineer, you will contribute directly to the design and development of complex analogue and mixed-signal subsystems across multiple high-speed IC programmes.
You will apply strong circuit-level design expertise to deliver robust, high-performance solutions while supporting the definition and optimisation of chip architecture to meet demanding performance, power, and area targets.
You will work closely with senior design engineers and cross-functional teams to ensure successful execution from concept through design, validation, and production.
Responsibilities:
• Work closely with the Design Lead to support chip development and take ownership of key analogue subsystems within larger IC programmes (20%).
• Deliver circuit and block-level analogue designs that meet performance, power, area, and reliability specifications defined by Product Definition and Marketing teams (20%).
• Collaborate closely with Layout Engineering teams to ensure post-layout performance alignment, including parasitic awareness and design optimisation (15%).
• Support end-to-end verification activities, ensuring simulated performance correlates with lab measurements during validation and bring-up phases (10%).
• Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Product Definition, Test, Verification, Reliability, and Product Engineering teams to ensure design alignment with system requirements (10%).
• Contribute to innovative circuit solutions and continuous improvement of analogue design methodologies and architectures (10%).
• Communicate and present technical work clearly and effectively to internal engineering teams and wider project stakeholders (10%).
• Support design reviews and contribute to technical discussions, ensuring high-quality engineering outputs and adherence to programme schedules (5%).
Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related technical discipline required
• 0–2 years of relevant industry experience in Analog IC design required
• Strong understanding of CMOS/BiCMOS analog circuit design principles and semiconductor device physics
• Good technical grounding in circuit theory, device behaviour, and design trade-offs (performance, power, area)
• Experience using Cadence design and simulation tools
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
Desired Qualifications:
• Master’s degree (MSc) or specialised analog IC design training preferred
• Exposure to RF / high-speed analog design (10GHz+) preferred
• Experience with Laser Driver and/or TIA circuit design preferred
• Understanding of RF/analog layout principles including floorplanning, parasitics, matching, ESD, crosstalk, and IR drop
• Exposure to high-frequency passive design (e.g. inductors, T-coils) and 3D modelling techniques
• Knowledge of device modelling (Verilog-AMS, SystemVerilog or equivalent)
• Understanding of DFM, yield optimisation, and semiconductor reliability principles
Important Qualities:
• Structured thinking with strong attention to detail
• Clear and confident communication skills, both written and verbal
• Collaborative mindset with ability to contribute within multidisciplinary teams
• Willingness to challenge ideas constructively and engage in technical debate
• Self-motivated with strong drive for technical excellence and continuous learning
Career Growth Philosophy:
At Semtech, we seek innovation and leadership from every member of our team. We invest in our people with the support, resources, and opportunity to excel — and we recognise and reward those who drive results.
This role provides a strong foundation for technical development in high-speed analog IC design, with clear opportunities to grow within a world-class engineering organisation.

Founded in 1896, Knight Frank was registered as Knight Frank LLP a Limited Liability Partnership, on 3 November 2003, registered in England & Wales at 55 Baker Street, London, W1U 8AN with the registered number of OC305934. Headquartered in London, UK, Knight Frank is one of the world's leading independent real estate consultancies. We work responsibly in partnership to enhance people's lives and environments in over 50 Markets, 600+ Offices, 20,000+ People, 1 Global Network.
At the heart of all we do are our Clients. A relationship built on trust is vital. As trusted partners in property, we act with integrity and care, understanding our clients’ unique needs and consistently thinking about the bigger picture to provide personalised, clear and considered advice across all areas of property. Through our deep understanding of key markets and sectors – both emerging and established – we are dedicated to meeting and exceeding their property goals.
A true partnership is a balanced one, and our People are passionate about, and committed to, making our business inclusive and diverse. We give every individual the space and opportunity to perform at their best and be recognised for the immense value they bring. We empower everyone to have autonomy in their role and encourage them to use their voice in how we can make a positive impact as a firm and shape the future of real estate, the built environment and the impact on the communities we serve. Our collaborative and engaged teams provide excellent and dedicated client service. In our workplace, opinions are respected, everyone is invited to contribute to the success of our business and innovation, and new ideas are celebrated.
In 2021 we celebrated our 125th anniversary and set out Our Desired Future, cemented in three pillars: People Potential, Client Centricity and always Creating our Future, together. Learn more about what sets us apart here.
About The Role
We’re on the lookout for a proactive and experienced Building / Property Manager to take the lead in managing daily operations and facilities for our properties. In this role, you’ll be responsible for ensuring that all systems are running smoothly—from mechanical and electrical to building safety and cleanliness. You'll also guide your team to deliver top-tier maintenance services while keeping costs in check. If you're someone who thrives on responsibility, enjoys leading people, and has a strong grasp of building operations, this role is an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful impact.
What You Will Be Doing
•
Lead the day-to-day operations of building and facilities management services, ensuring everything runs efficiently and safely.
•
Plan and coordinate preventive, routine, and ad-hoc maintenance works for building systems and equipment.
•
Supervise contractors and ensure maintenance works meet safety, quality, and contract standards.
•
Conduct regular building audits and inspections to ensure compliance with statutory regulations and internal quality programs.
•
Ensure all new installation works meet building codes and regulatory requirements.
•
Handle feedback and complaints from tenants and stakeholders, ensuring timely follow-up and resolution.
•
Prepare monthly reports for management and clients on building operations and maintenance status.
•
Manage building risk and implement safety and emergency protocols, including security measures.
•
Drive energy-saving and sustainability initiatives to help reduce operating costs.
•
Monitor maintenance budgets and ensure timely payments to contractors and service providers in accordance with cash flow projections.
What We’re Looking For Someone Who’s
•
Hold a Degree in Facilities Management, Building, Real Estate, or Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, with at least 5 years of experience in building or facilities management.
•
Have strong knowledge of M&E systems, car park operations, and is conversant with relevant codes of practice and regulations.
•
Bring strong leadership and communication skills to manage teams and engage with stakeholders effectively.
•
Highly preferred someone who possess relevant professional certifications such as FSM, Green Mark, ZWM, WEM, SIFMA Tier 1–4, IFMA, or SCEM.
•
Well-organized, meticulous, and capable of managing multiple moving parts while staying on top of compliance and operational standards.
Why Knight Frank?
•
Lots of opportunities for growth and career development.
•
A supportive, collaborative team that values what you bring to the table.
•
Continuous learning and development to help you advance.
If you’re ready to make an impact and grow your career in property management, we’d love to hear from you!
Competitive salary

Are you an experienced commercial, procurement or supply chain specialist looking to pivot your commercial expertise into a change role with the focus on project managing the introduction of a new contracting life management tool for the UK function?
If so, come and join our Governance and Performance Team in Procurement UK.
Salary: Circa £45,000 depending on experience
Dynamic (hybrid) working: 2-3 days per week on-site due to workload classification
Security Clearance: British Citizen or a Dual UK national with British citizenship
Restrictions and/or limitations relating to nationality and/or rights to work may apply. As a minimum and after offer stage, all successful candidates will need to undergo HMG Basic Personnel Security Standard checks (BPSS), which are managed by the MBDA Personnel Security Team.
What we can offer you:
• Company bonus: Up to £2,500 (based on company performance and will vary year to year)
• Pension: maximum total (employer and employee) contribution of up to 14%
• Overtime: opportunity for paid overtime
• Flexi Leave: Up to 15 additional days
• Flexible working: We welcome applicants who are looking for flexible working arrangements
• Enhanced parental leave: offers up to 26 weeks for maternity, adoption and shared parental leave -enhancements are available for paternity leave, neonatal leave and fertility testing and treatments
• Facilities: Fantastic site facilities including subsidised meals, free car parking and much more…
• Healthcare Cash Plan: The Healthcare Cash Plan benefit provides the option to claim cash back on everyday healthcare expenses such as optical, dental, health and wellbeing and more.
The opportunity:
Following a recent company re-organisation MBDA’s UK Procurement function has introduced a ‘Governance and Performance’ team to support the function’s drive to deliver excellence to our customers by ensuring robust governance, performance management and compliance across all of our Procurement activities.  Your primary role will be to act as the project manager for Procurement UK Contract Life Cycle Management tool selection and implementation focusing on:
• Using strong stakeholder management skills to understand what the various functions in Procurement UK need from this tool, manage expectations and maintain alignment between the various procurement teams, legal operations, and technical deployment teams.
• Supporting the development of the Procurement requirements for the tool to enable supplier proposals to be requested along with actively reviewing these submissions against the needs of the function.
• Review and testing of the offered solutions to ensure that procurement realities and commercial workflows are integrated into the new CLM solution.
• Proactively research and map out existing contracting structures to ensure the tool's deployment addresses real-world business bottlenecks.
• Developing the appropriate user guides and training to support roll out and implementation to the wider function.
You will also support the wider Governance and Performance UK function by contributing to broader change management, compliance, and functional improvement initiatives as required.
What we‘re looking for from you:
You do not need to be a technical systems implementation expert; instead, we are looking for a proactive self-starter with a good supply chain or commercial knowledge who can gather and analyse business needs, manage critical stakeholders, and project manage this activity to ensure the new tool aligns with practical procurement operations.
• Solid experience working within a commercial, procurement or supply chain function (ideally in a regulated business sector), with an understanding of commercial contract structures, legal operations, risk management, and the full contract negotiation lifecycle.
• A results-oriented approach with the proactivity to drive projects to completion.
• An excellent business stakeholder manager with a proven ability to build national and international relationships, influence cross-functional teams, and align diverse business interests.
• Excellent communication skills and ability to present concepts in a clear and structured way.
• A natural researcher who can independently investigate current procurement workflows, gather user requirements, and proactively identify opportunities for process improvement.
• Experience creating structured training playbooks or user guides from scratch.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office, knowledge of SAP would be beneficial.
• Willingness to travel to UK and non-UK sites as required.
Our company: Peace is not a given, Freedom is not a given, Sovereignty is not a given
MBDA is a leading defence organisation.  We are proud of the role we play in supporting the Armed Forces who protect our nations. We partner with governments to work together towards a common goal, defending our freedom.
We are proud of our employee-led networks, examples include: Gender Equality, Pride, Menopause Matters, Parents and Carers, Armed Forces, Ethnic Diversity, Neurodiversity, Disability and more…
We recognise that everyone is unique, and we encourage you to speak to us should you require any advice, support or adjustments throughout our recruitment process.
Follow us on LinkedIn (MBDA), X (@MBDA_UK), Instagram (MBDA_UK) and Glassdoor or visit our MBDA Careers website for more information.

beautyhealth.wd12.myworkdayjobs.com/beau.description_excerpt:
About Us
Hydrafacial is a global category-creating company focused on bringing innovative products to market and delivering beauty health experiences by reinventing our consumer’s relationship with their skin, their bodies and their self-confidence.
Every person here is a key player in our success.  We are firm believers in making the little things count each day so the big things will follow. If this sounds like you, come check us out! This is the perfect opportunity to work with some of the best leaders in the industry while you gain the global and strategic experience to add to your professional toolbox.
Job Description:
WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS
Accurate and timely incentive compensation administration is essential to ensuring employees understand and trust how their performance translates into compensation. As SkinHealth Systems continues to grow internationally, the Senior Incentive Compensation Analyst, OUS provides analytical and operational support for international incentive compensation programs.
This role supports recurring compensation calculations, data validation, participant tracking, reporting, reconciliation and payment processes in accordance with approved incentive plans and established controls, including applicable SOX requirements. Working closely with Total Rewards and cross-functional partners, the Senior Analyst helps maintain accurate compensation data, identify and resolve discrepancies, and ensure incentive compensation activities are completed accurately and on schedule across international markets.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
• Support recurring administration of incentive compensation plans for international employees, including participant tracking, data preparation, calculation support, validation, reconciliation, and payment coordination.
• Prepare and validate incentive compensation calculations using approved plan provisions, established methodologies, and applicable sales and performance data.
• Collect, consolidate, and review compensation inputs from Sales Operations, Finance, Payroll, HR, and regional stakeholders to ensure completeness and accuracy prior to calculation and payment.
• Maintain incentive compensation trackers, calculation files, participant records, plan documentation, and supporting materials in accordance with established processes and SOX requirements.
• Research calculation and data discrepancies and coordinate with appropriate stakeholders to resolve routine issues, escalating complex matters or plan interpretation questions as appropriate.
• Process employee changes impacting incentive compensation, including new hires, transfers, promotions, leaves, terminations, territory changes, and other organizational changes.
• Assist with implementation of approved new or revised incentive compensation plans by updating calculation tools, templates, participant information, and supporting documentation.
• Perform testing and validation of compensation calculations and process changes using established requirements and expected outcomes.
• Prepare recurring incentive compensation reports and analyses, including payout, attainment, adjustment, and reconciliation reporting.
• Support reconciliation of incentive compensation calculations and payments with Payroll and Finance records and assist with resolution of identified discrepancies.
• Respond to routine incentive compensation inquiries and provide calculation details or supporting information, escalating complex questions and exceptions as appropriate.
• Collaborate with other members of the incentive compensation function to support process alignment, data validation, issue resolution and continuity of operations across incentive compensation programs organization-wide.
• Support periodic audits and reviews by gathering requested documentation, calculation support, and other relevant records.
• Identify administrative or process improvement opportunities and provide recommendations to Total Rewards leadership.
• Perform other duties as assigned.
WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
Required
• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related field.
• 3+ years of experience in compensation analysis, finance, sales operations, payroll, or a related analytical function.
• Experience working with financial, compensation, sales, or other complex data sets.
• Experience working with incentive compensation or commission calculation software, such as Xactly, Forma.ai, or similar platform.
• Strong analytical and quantitative skills with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and data analysis.
• Ability to interpret documented plan provisions and apply established calculation methodologies.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage recurring deadlines and multiple priorities.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional and international stakeholders.
• Ability to handle sensitive compensation and employee information with appropriate confidentiality.
Preferred
• Experience supporting sales or incentive compensation administration.
• Experience supporting employees or business operations across multiple international markets.
• Familiarity with incentive compensation systems or tools.
• Experience working within a publicly traded and/or SOX-controlled environment.
• Experience with Workday or similar HRIS platforms.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS OF THE JOB
• Primarily office-based environment; prolonged periods of sitting while working at a computer.
• Ability to participate in virtual meetings and collaborate across international time zones.
• Must be able to operate standard office equipment and analytical software tools.
The base salary range for this role is £68,000 - £74,000 gross annually. Final compensation will be determined based on objective, job-related factors including skills, experience, location, and internal equity.
